Cyber crime FIRs of all kinds rose from 65,893 in 2022 to 86,420 in 2023 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]] and 1,01,928 in 2024, up 17.9% in a year [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]]. A category that shrinks while its whole family grows is more likely shrinking in the register than in real life.

NCRB itself warns that a rise in registered crime and a rise in crime are two different things [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. The logic runs in reverse too. NCRB counts each FIR once, under its most serious offence [[ncrb-cii-2024]], so a stalker who also threatens, extorts or posts sexual images may be filed under that heavier crime. And the switch from the IPC to the BNS on 1 July 2024 split that year's data into two codes [[pib-mha-new-criminal-laws-2026]], which makes year-on-year comparisons shakier.

## 1,240 against 9,865: where online stalking sits in the data

Stalking of every kind, under Section 78 of the BNS and the old Section 354D of the IPC, produced 9,865 FIRs in 2024, down from 10,495 in 2023: 1.4 cases per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The two numbers come from different chapters of NCRB's report and may overlap, and the cyber figure also covers children, so 1,240 is not a slice of 9,865 that can be turned into a percentage. What the comparison does show is how thin the online count is: in a year with 1,01,928 cyber crime FIRs, only 1,240 were filed as stalking or bullying of women and children.

There is a second gap. By its wording, only a man can commit stalking under Section 78 [[indiacode-bns-2023]], and NCRB records it as a crime against women. Men, and many trans and queer people, who are stalked online may have to fit their complaints into other offences, and into other columns.

## The court queue: 4,348 cases, 33 convictions

Registration is only the first filter. In 2024, 4,348 cases of cyber stalking or bullying of women and children were before Indian courts. Only 33 ended in conviction: a 22.8% conviction rate among the trials that finished, with 95.3% of cases still pending at the end of the year [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Put plainly, fewer than one in four completed trials ended in a conviction. The 4,348 include cases from earlier years, so the 33 cannot be matched to 2024's FIRs; it is the national total of convictions for the year. Stalking of all kinds fares only a little better, with a 25.2% conviction rate and 92.8% pendency [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A stalking case lives on screenshots, account names and timestamps. Every year in the queue is a year in which phones are replaced, accounts deleted and memories blurred.

## What surveys catch that police records miss

Surveys that ask people directly show how much never reaches a police station. In 2005, 12% of Indian households told the India Human Development Survey that unmarried girls were "sometimes" or "often" harassed in their neighbourhood; police records implied 0.06%, a gap of about 200 times [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]]. That was harassment in the neighbourhood, before smartphones. There is no reason to think harassment through a phone is better recorded.

The silence is wider than stalking. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone, and of those who sought help, only 6% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

For the woman in Pune, the reasons not to file are easy to list: the fear that a complaint will provoke him, that an officer will say "just block him", that her family will take her phone away.

## Building a case that survives

This is general information, not legal advice. Stalking carries up to three years in prison on first conviction and up to five on a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. These steps help a case get that far:

- **Keep a log, not just screenshots.** Date, time, platform, account name and link, and what was said. Every new account after a block belongs in it.
- **Make screenshots prove themselves.** Keep the profile link, date and time in the frame, back the files up where the stalker cannot reach them, and keep the phone or a full backup until the case ends.
- **File early, anywhere.** You can report at any police station, wherever the stalking happened, or by e-FIR, signed within three days, and you must get a free copy of the FIR; a woman's stalking complaint must be recorded by a woman officer [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. The cyber crime helpline is 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].
- **Be ready for an enquiry.** Because stalking carries up to three years, police may, with a Deputy Superintendent's permission, hold a preliminary enquiry of up to 14 days before registering it [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Organised evidence on day one leaves less room for doubt.
- **Get your statement on record.** In stalking cases a magistrate, as far as practicable a woman, must record the survivor's statement as soon as police learn of the offence [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. At trial, evidence of her character or sexual history is irrelevant to any question of consent [[indiacode-bsa-2023]].

A falling line is easy to celebrate. Until the 1,240 rises because more survivors are heard, and the 33 rises because more cases are finished, it is not good news.
cyberstalking-cases-fall-courts-stall.hg:
Socho, Pune mein ek 22 saal ki ladki hai. Woh college ke ek purane classmate ko saaf kehti hai ki message karna band karo, phir use block kar deti hai. Ek hafte baad woh ek naye account se wapas aa jata hai, phir ek aur account se, phir uski behen ke inbox mein, phir uske office ki posts ke neeche comments mein. Woh police ke paas nahi jaati, isliye India ke crime data mein woh kabhi dikhti hi nahi. Agar woh complaint karti, to uska case ek aisi court queue mein lagta jisme 2024 mein har 20 mein se 19 se zyada case saal ke end tak intezaar hi kar rahe the. Yeh kisi ladke ya trans insaan ke saath bhi ho sakta hai, jinhe stalking ka main law shayad cover hi na kare.

## Lagatar do saal girti FIRs

Police ne auraton aur bachchon ki cyber stalking ya bullying ke 2022 mein 1,471 case darj kiye, 2023 mein 1,305 aur 2024 mein 1,240 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Akele dekho to yeh line progress jaisi lagti hai.

Par iske aas-paas sab kuch ulti disha mein gaya. Har tarah ke cyber crime ki FIRs 2022 mein 65,893 se badhkar 2023 mein 86,420 hui [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]] aur 2024 mein 1,01,928, yaani ek saal mein 17.9% ki badhotri [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]]. Jab poora parivaar badh raha ho aur usi ki ek category sikud rahi ho, to zyada sambhavna yahi hai ki woh asli zindagi mein nahi, register mein sikud rahi hai.

NCRB khud warn karta hai ki darj crime ka badhna aur crime ka badhna do alag cheezein hain [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Yahi logic ulta bhi lagta hai. NCRB har FIR ko sirf ek baar, uske sabse serious offence ke under ginta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]], isliye jo stalker dhamki bhi deta hai, paise bhi ainthta hai ya sexual images bhi post karta hai, uska case us bhaari crime ke under darj ho sakta hai. Aur 1 July 2024 ko IPC ki jagah BNS aane se us saal ka data do codes mein bant gaya [[pib-mha-new-criminal-laws-2026]], jisse saal-dar-saal ki tulna aur kamzor ho jaati hai.

## 1,240 banaam 9,865: data mein online stalking kahan hai

Har tarah ki stalking, yaani BNS ka Section 78 aur IPC ka purana Section 354D, ki 2024 mein 9,865 FIRs hui, jo 2023 ke 10,495 se kam hain: har lakh auraton par 1.4 case [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Yeh dono numbers NCRB report ke alag-alag chapters se aate hain aur ek doosre mein overlap ho sakte hain, aur cyber wale figure mein bachche bhi shaamil hain, isliye 1,240 ko 9,865 ka hissa maan kar percentage nahi nikala ja sakta. Par yeh tulna itna zaroor dikhati hai ki online ginti kitni patli hai: jis saal 1,01,928 cyber crime FIRs hui, usme sirf 1,240 auraton aur bachchon ki stalking ya bullying ke roop mein darj hui.

Ek doosra gap bhi hai. Section 78 ke shabdon ke hisaab se stalking sirf ek mard kar sakta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]], aur NCRB ise auraton ke khilaaf crime ke roop mein record karta hai. Jo mard, aur bahut se trans aur queer log, online stalk hote hain, unhe apni complaint shayad doosre offences mein, aur doosre columns mein, fit karni padti hai.

## Court ki queue: 4,348 case, 33 convictions

Registration bas pehli chhalni hai. 2024 mein auraton aur bachchon ki cyber stalking ya bullying ke 4,348 case Indian courts ke saamne the. Sirf 33 mein conviction hua: jo trials poore hue, unme 22.8% conviction rate, aur saal ke end tak 95.3% case pending [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Seedhe shabdon mein, jo trials poore hue unme se 4 mein se 1 se bhi kam conviction tak pahunche. 4,348 mein pichhle saalon ke case bhi hain, isliye 33 ko 2024 ki FIRs se mila kar nahi dekha ja sakta; yeh poore saal mein poore desh ke convictions ka total hai. Har tarah ki stalking ka haal thoda hi behtar hai: 25.2% conviction rate aur 92.8% pendency [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Stalking ka case screenshots, account ke naamon aur timestamps par tika hota hai. Queue mein guzra har saal woh saal hai jisme phone badal jaate hain, accounts delete ho jaate hain aur yaadein dhundhli pad jaati hain.

## Surveys woh pakadte hain jo police records se chhoot jaata hai

Jo surveys logon se seedha poochhte hain, woh dikhate hain ki kitna kuch police station tak pahunchta hi nahi. 2005 mein 12% Indian households ne India Human Development Survey ko bataya ki unke mohalle mein unmarried ladkiyon ko "kabhi-kabhi" ya "aksar" pareshaan kiya jata hai; police records ke hisaab se yeh figure sirf 0.06% banta tha, yaani lagbhag 200 guna ka farak [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]]. Woh mohalle ka harassment tha, smartphones se pehle ka. Yeh maanne ki koi wajah nahi ki phone ke zariye hone wala harassment behtar record hota hoga.

Yeh chuppi stalking se bhi badi hai. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein jin auraton ne physical ya sexual violence jhela tha, unme se 77% ne kabhi madad nahi maangi ya kisi ko bataya tak nahi, aur jinhone madad maangi unme se sirf 6% police ke paas gayi [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Pune wali ladki ke liye complaint na karne ki wajahen ginna aasaan hai: dar ki complaint se woh aur bhadak jayega, ki koi officer kahega "bas block kar do", ki ghar wale uska phone hi le lenge.

## Aisa case banao jo tike

Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi. Stalking par pehli conviction mein 3 saal tak ki jail hai aur dobara hone par 5 saal tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yeh kadam case ko wahan tak pahunchane mein madad karte hain:

- **Sirf screenshots nahi, log rakho.** Date, time, platform, account ka naam aur link, aur kya kaha gaya. Block ke baad bana har naya account bhi isme jaana chahiye.
- **Screenshots aise lo ki woh khud saboot ban jaayein.** Profile link, date aur time frame mein rakho, files ka backup aisi jagah rakho jahan stalker na pahunch sake, aur case khatam hone tak phone ya uska poora backup sambhal kar rakho.
- **Jaldi file karo, kahin bhi.** Tum kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte ho, stalking chahe kahin bhi hui ho, ya e-FIR ke zariye, jise 3 din ke andar sign karna hota hai, aur tumhe FIR ki copy free milni chahiye; kisi aurat ki stalking ki complaint ek woman officer ko hi record karni hogi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Cyber crime helpline 1930 hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].
- **Enquiry ke liye taiyaar raho.** Kyunki stalking mein 3 saal tak ki saza hai, police Deputy Superintendent ki permission se case darj karne se pehle 14 din tak ki preliminary enquiry kar sakti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Pehle hi din saboot saja kar doge, to shak ki gunjaish kam rahegi.
- **Apna statement record karwao.** Stalking ke case mein ek magistrate, jahan tak ho sake ek woman magistrate, ko police ko offence ka pata chalte hi survivor ka statement record karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Trial mein consent ke kisi bhi sawaal par uske character ya sexual history ka saboot relevant nahi maana jata [[indiacode-bsa-2023]].

Girti hui line ka jashn manana aasaan hai. Jab tak 1,240 isliye na badhe ki zyada survivors ki sunvaai ho rahi hai, aur 33 isliye na badhe ki zyada case poore ho rahe hain, tab tak yeh achhi khabar nahi hai.

dating-app-safety-india-guide.en:
Consider a hypothetical 24-year-old in Pune. She matches with a man whose profile says he is an engineer in Bengaluru. On day two he says the app keeps crashing and asks for her WhatsApp number. By week two he is talking about meeting her parents. By week three comes the request: a private photo "to prove you trust me", or money for an emergency. The same script reaches men, usually ending in a demand for money, and queer users, who may have the most to lose from a screenshot. This guide turns India's crime data into habits that break it. Its legal parts are general information, not legal advice.

## What the data say about 'online friends'

India's crime data has no column for dating apps. It does record who the accused was. Of 29,536 rape cases registered in 2024, the accused was known to the survivor in 28,597, or 96.8% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The largest group, 13,879 cases, is "friends, online friends or live-in partners on the pretext of marriage, or separated husbands". Family members accounted for 2,134 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

That category lumps last month's match together with a college friend and an estranged husband, so nobody can say how many cases began on an app. It counts FIRs, not assaults, and sexual violence is heavily under-reported; a woman raped by a husband she still lives with is not counted at all.

What the table does show is where the risk sits: rarely with a stranger in a dark lane, usually with someone who stopped being a stranger. A dating app exists to make that happen fast. That is its value, and the reason to slow it down.

## Section 69: when a promise is a crime

Since 1 July 2024, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) has had a separate offence for sex obtained by "deceitful means", or by a promise to marry a woman made with no intention of keeping it, where the act does not amount to rape. It carries up to 10 years. "Deceitful means" includes a false promise of a job or promotion, and marrying while hiding one's identity [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

In its first six months, July to December 2024, police registered 1,325 cases under Section 69 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and recorded 99 cases under it as cyber crimes, where a phone or computer was the tool [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Two limits matter. The section is written for a woman complainant, so men and many queer users deceived the same way cannot use it. And a relationship that simply ends is not a crime: the question is whether the promise was false when it was made.

## The catfish script, step by step

Catfishing, building a fake identity to draw someone in, is the doorway to much online harm. In a 2023 Snap survey of more than 6,000 teens and young adults in six countries including India, 65% said they or their friends had been targeted in sextortion schemes through catfishing or hacking [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. The figure is pooled and counts friends, so read it as a sign of how common the attempt is, not as an Indian rate.

The details change. The steps repeat:

1. **The polished profile.** Professional-looking photos, and a job that keeps them away: abroad, at sea, on a project.
2. **The move.** "This app is buggy, let's talk on WhatsApp." Off the app, nobody moderates the chat, and your number can reveal your display picture and, on payment apps, your registered name.
3. **The rush.** Daily affection and talk of marriage within days, while the video call keeps getting postponed.
4. **The test.** A request for an intimate photo or a video call "just for us". A recorded call is the raw material of the commonest sextortion racket: a fake profile, often posing as a woman, records it for blackmail, sometimes followed by calls from fake "police". Police in Rajasthan's Alwar district caught more than 60 such gangs in the year to September 2021 [[bhaskar-alwar-sextortion-2021]].
5. **The ask.** A hospital bill, a customs fee on a gift, an investment tip, or a threat. Fraud was the motive in 72.6% of India's cyber crime cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]].

## Before you meet: verification and a safety plan

- **Verify on a live video call** before you leave the app, and before feelings make it awkward to ask.
- **Search their photos.** A reverse image search often finds a stolen face on someone else's account.
- **Check the story.** Does the workplace exist? Does anyone you know know them? A verification badge is a start, not proof.
- **Hold back intimate images.** Sharing a woman's private image without her consent is voyeurism under BNS Section 77 even if she agreed to the photo [[indiacode-bns-2023]], and IT Act Section 66E protects anyone [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. But the law acts after the harm.
- **Meet in public, travel on your own, and tell a friend** the profile, place, time and when you will check in. Leave whenever you want.

Under 18? Dating apps are for adults. Any adult who asks a child for a sexual image, or draws a child into an online sexual relationship, commits an offence under IT Act Section 67B [[indiacode-it-act-2000]], and sexual contact with anyone under 18 is a crime under POCSO whatever they say. If this is happening to you, it is not your fault: tell an adult you trust or call 1098.

None of this makes harm your fault if it happens. It shifts the odds and gives you exits.

## If something goes wrong

- **If you are blackmailed, don't pay.** Paying does not guarantee deletion. A study cited by WeProtect in its 2024 brief on sextortion of young people found that 70% of victims who ignored payment demands did not have their images distributed [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]].
- **Save evidence before you block**: profile screenshots, chats, numbers, payment IDs. Then report and block.
- **Report** at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. If an intimate image is posted, complain to the platform: since 20 February 2026 it has two hours to remove nude, sexual or morphed images after your complaint [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].
- **If you were assaulted**, you can report at any police station whatever the area, or electronically, and you get a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. In an emergency, call 112.

A match is a stranger with good photos until proven otherwise. Going slowly is not paranoia. It is the one thing every script is built to stop.
dating-app-safety-india-guide.hg:
Ek hypothetical situation sochiye: Pune ki ek 24 saal ki ladki. Uska match ek aadmi se hota hai jiski profile kehti hai ki woh Bengaluru mein engineer hai. Doosre din woh kehta hai ki app baar baar crash ho raha hai aur uska WhatsApp number maangta hai. Doosre hafte tak woh uske parents se milne ki baat karne lagta hai. Teesre hafte demand aati hai: ek private photo "yeh dikhane ke liye ki tum mujh par trust karti ho", ya kisi emergency ke liye paisa. Yahi script men tak bhi pahunchti hai, jahan aksar end mein paise ki demand hoti hai, aur queer users tak bhi, jinke liye ek screenshot sabse zyada nuksaan kar sakta hai. Yeh guide India ke crime data ko aisi habits mein badalti hai jo is script ko tod dein. Iske legal hisse general information hain, legal advice nahi.

## 'Online friends' ke baare mein data kya kehta hai

India ke crime data mein dating apps ka koi column nahi hai. Lekin yeh record hota hai ki accused kaun tha. 2024 mein darj 29,536 rape cases mein se 28,597 mein, yaani 96.8% mein, accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Sabse bada group, 13,879 cases, hai "friends, online friends ya shaadi ke bahane live-in partners, ya alag reh rahe husbands". Family members 2,134 cases mein the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Yeh category pichhle mahine ke match ko college friend aur alag ho chuke husband ke saath ek hi dabbe mein daal deti hai, isliye koi nahi bata sakta ki kitne cases app se shuru hue. Yeh FIRs ginti hai, assaults nahi, aur sexual violence bahut kam report hota hai; jis aurat ka rape us husband ne kiya jiske saath woh abhi bhi rehti hai, woh toh gini hi nahi jaati.

Table yeh zaroor dikhata hai ki risk kahan hai: andheri gali ke anjaan aadmi ke paas kabhi kabhaar, aur zyada tar us insaan ke paas jo anjaan nahi raha. Dating app ka kaam hi yahi hai ki yeh sab tezi se ho. Yahi uski value hai, aur yahi wajah hai ki is process ko dheema kiya jaaye.

## Section 69: jab ek vaada crime ban jaata hai

1 July 2024 se Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) mein ek alag offence hai: "deceitful means" se, ya kisi woman se aisa shaadi ka vaada karke jise nibhane ka koi iraada hi nahi tha, sex haasil karna, jahan act rape ki category mein nahi aata. Isme 10 saal tak ki saza hai. "Deceitful means" mein naukri ya promotion ka jhootha vaada, aur apni identity chhupa kar shaadi karna bhi shaamil hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Iske pehle chhe mahine mein, July se December 2024 tak, police ne Section 69 ke tahat 1,325 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur iske 99 cases cyber crime ke roop mein darj hue, jahan phone ya computer hi zariya tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Do limits samajhna zaroori hai. Yeh section ek woman complainant ke liye likha gaya hai, isliye isi tarah dhokha khaane wale men aur kai queer users iska sahara nahi le sakte. Aur ek relationship jo bas khatam ho gaya, woh crime nahi hai: sawaal yeh hai ki vaada karte waqt hi woh jhootha tha ya nahi.

## Catfish script, step by step

Catfishing, yaani kisi ko phansane ke liye fake identity banana, bahut saare online harm ka darwaza hai. 2023 ke ek Snap survey mein, India samet chhe deshon ke 6,000 se zyada teens aur young adults mein se 65% ne kaha ki unhe ya unke friends ko catfishing ya hacking ke zariye sextortion schemes mein target kiya gaya [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. Yeh pooled figure hai aur isme friends bhi gine gaye hain, isliye ise yeh samjhiye ki koshish kitni common hai, India ka rate nahi.

Details badalti rehti hain. Steps wahi rehte hain:

1. **Chamakti hui profile.** Professional jaisi photos, aur aisi job jo unhe door rakhti hai: abroad, ship par, kisi project par.
2. **Shift.** "Yeh app buggy hai, WhatsApp pe baat karte hain." App ke bahar chat ko koi moderate nahi karta, aur aapka number aapki display picture dikha sakta hai aur payment apps par aapka registered naam bhi.
3. **Jaldbaazi.** Roz pyaar bhari baatein aur kuch hi dinon mein shaadi ki baat, jabki video call baar baar taal di jaati hai.
4. **Test.** Ek intimate photo ki demand ya "sirf hum dono ke liye" video call. Record ki gayi call sabse common sextortion racket ka raw material hai: ek fake profile, aksar woman banke, call record karti hai aur blackmail karti hai, kabhi kabhi uske baad nakli "police" ke calls bhi aate hain. Rajasthan ke Alwar district mein police ne September 2021 tak ke ek saal mein aise 60 se zyada gangs pakde [[bhaskar-alwar-sextortion-2021]].
5. **Demand.** Hospital ka bill, gift par customs fee, koi investment tip, ya seedhi dhamki. 2024 mein India ke cyber crime cases mein se 72.6% mein motive fraud tha [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]].

## Milne se pehle: verification aur safety plan

- **Live video call par verify kijiye**, app chhodne se pehle, aur us se pehle ki feelings ki wajah se poochna awkward lagne lage.
- **Unki photos search kijiye.** Reverse image search aksar kisi aur ke account par chura hua chehra dhoondh leta hai.
- **Kahani check kijiye.** Kya woh workplace exist karta hai? Kya aapke jaan-pehchaan mein koi unhe jaanta hai? Verification badge shuruaat hai, saboot nahi.
- **Intimate photos rok kar rakhiye.** Kisi woman ki private image uski consent ke bina share karna BNS Section 77 ke tahat voyeurism hai, chahe usne photo khinchwane ke liye haan kaha ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]], aur IT Act ka Section 66E kisi bhi insaan ko protect karta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Lekin law nuksaan hone ke baad hi kaam karta hai.
- **Public jagah par miliye, wahan khud jaiye, aur ek friend ko batayiye**: profile, jagah, time, aur aap kab check-in karenge. Jab chahe nikal jaiye.

18 se kam hain? Dating apps adults ke liye hain. Koi bhi adult jo kisi bachche se sexual image maangta hai, ya use online sexual relationship mein kheenchta hai, IT Act Section 67B ke tahat offence karta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]], aur 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sexual contact POCSO ke tahat crime hai, chahe woh kuch bhi kahe. Agar aapke saath aisa ho raha hai, toh galti aapki nahi hai: kisi bharosemand adult ko bataiye ya 1098 par call kijiye.

Inme se kuch bhi yeh nahi kehta ki agar kuch bura hua toh galti aapki hai. Yeh bas risk kam karta hai aur aapko nikalne ke raaste deta hai.

## Agar kuch galat ho jaaye

- **Agar blackmail ho raha hai, toh pay mat kijiye.** Paisa dene se photo delete hone ki koi guarantee nahi. WeProtect ki 2024 ki young logon ke sextortion par brief mein cite ki gayi ek study ke mutabik, jin victims ne payment ki demand ignore ki, unme se 70% ki images share nahi ki gayi [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]].
- **Block karne se pehle evidence save kijiye**: profile ke screenshots, chats, numbers, payment IDs. Phir report aur block kijiye.
- **Report kijiye** cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. Agar koi intimate image post ho gayi hai, toh platform ko complaint kijiye: 20 February 2026 se uske paas aapki complaint ke baad nude, sexual ya morphed images hatane ke liye sirf do ghante hain [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].
- **Agar aap par assault hua hai**, toh aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte hain, area chahe jo ho, ya electronically bhi, aur aapko FIR ki free copy milti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye.

Jab tak saabit na ho, match bas achhi photos wala ek anjaan insaan hai. Dheere chalna paranoia nahi hai. Yahi woh cheez hai jise rokne ke liye har script banayi jaati hai.

fake-porn-app-ads-phone-takeover.en:
The ad sits in a Facebook or Instagram feed like any other, offering an adult video app with a name such as "Night Play", "Reloop" or "Kyss". What it delivers, India's cyber crime agency says, is someone else's control of your phone. On 26 August 2026 the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) issued advisory TAU/ADV/018, warning that fake pornography apps advertised on those two platforms under such names were being used to take over Android phones and commit financial fraud [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]].

Whoever installed such an app is the victim of a fraud, not the offender. This guide covers the trap, the warning signs and the first hour after you tap install.

## The ad, the download, the takeover

The advisory's title lays out the chain: "Malicious Side Loaded Pornographic Android Apps leading to Unauthorized Financial Transactions". It reports "a rise in financial frauds perpetrated through malicious Android applications masquerading as pornography apps", and lists more names: "Vimo", "Rivo", "Nexo" and "Vixa" [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. The names will change. The method runs in four moves.

1. **The ad.** It appears on a mainstream platform, which lends it credibility it has not earned.
2. **The download.** The link does not open the official app store. It hands over an installer file, and Android asks you to allow installs from an unknown source. That is side-loading.
3. **The permission.** The app asks for accessibility access, the permission the advisory ties to the takeover.
4. **The money.** With that control, the app is used for what the advisory calls unauthorised financial transactions: money leaves your account without your approval.

## Why side-loaded apps are the open door

An app store is not a guarantee, but it is a checkpoint: apps are screened, and can be removed when users report them. A side-loaded file skips it.

Accessibility access is the second door. The feature lets people with visual or motor disabilities have the screen read aloud or operated for them. In a malicious app, the same power can be used to read what is on your screen and to tap and type as if it were you. No video app needs it.

The lure is sexual; the motive is money. Fraud was the motive in 73,987 of India's 1,01,928 cyber crime cases in 2024, or 72.6%, against 3.1% for sexual exploitation, the next largest motive [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]]. Those are FIRs. The national cyber crime portal took 22.68 lakh complaints that year, and most portal complaints concern financial fraud [[ls-uq432-2025]].

Our reading: pornography makes good bait because the person who takes it is the one least likely to tell anyone.

## Red flags before you tap 'install'

- **The link leaves the app store.** A "download APK" button, or a prompt to allow installs from unknown sources, is the stop sign.
- **You cannot find the app yourself.** Search its name in the Play Store. If it is not there, walk away.
- **It asks for too much.** Accessibility access, permission to read SMS and device-admin rights have nothing to do with playing video.
- **It asks you to lower your guard.** A page that tells you to switch off Play Protect or ignore a security warning is telling you what it is.
- **It was "on Instagram".** An ad is paid placement, not a safety check [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]].

## Already installed? What to do right now

Imagine a 19-year-old in Nagpur on a hand-me-down phone that still has his father's UPI app on it. He installs one of these apps at midnight; by morning there are debit alerts. What costs him most now is every hour he spends deciding whether he can tell anyone. Speed matters most, so do these in order.

1. **Go offline.** Switch on aeroplane mode, or turn off mobile data and Wi-Fi, so the app cannot reach its operator.
2. **Call your bank from another phone.** Use the number printed on your card or passbook, not one from a search result. Ask the bank to block cards, UPI and net banking, and note the complaint number.
3. **Report it.** Call 1930, the toll-free cyber crime helpline, or file at cybercrime.gov.in, the portal run by I4C [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]] [[cybercrime-portal]]. Keep transaction IDs ready.
4. **Save the evidence.** Before you clean up, screenshot the app's name and icon, the ad or link, and every transaction SMS.
5. **Remove the app.** In Settings, switch off its accessibility access and any device-admin rights, then uninstall it. If it will not go, back up photos and contacts and factory-reset the phone.
6. **Change passwords from a clean device.** Banking and UPI PIN first, then email, then social media.

## Reporting without shame

Fraud built on a sexual lure depends on silence, as sextortion shows. A senior Maharashtra Cyber police officer estimated in a March 2022 op-ed that fewer than 0.5% of sextortion cases in India are registered as FIRs, and linked that to shame and stigma [[toi-yadav-sextortion-oped-2022]]. That is one officer's estimate about a different crime, not a measured rate. The mechanism is the same.

Three things should make the call easier. For an adult, watching adult pornography in private is not an offence in India; in July 2015 the Supreme Court observed that it could not stop an adult from watching it in the privacy of their room [[hindu-sc-adult-porn-privacy-2015]]. Your complaint only needs to describe a malicious app and unauthorised transactions. And if you are under 18 and this happened on a family phone, you were still defrauded: tell a parent or another adult you trust today, because the account at risk is probably theirs. This is general information, not legal advice.

A report may not bring the money back, and courts are slow: 90.9% of the cyber crime cases before Indian courts in 2024 were still pending at year end [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Report anyway, and fast. A blocked account stops the next transaction, and a complaint on record is what your bank and the police act on. The people behind the app are counting on you being too embarrassed to call.
fake-porn-app-ads-phone-takeover.hg:
Ad Facebook ya Instagram feed mein baaki ads ki tarah hi dikhta hai, aur "Night Play", "Reloop" ya "Kyss" jaise kisi naam se ek adult video app offer karta hai. India ki cyber crime agency ke mutabiq, asal mein jo milta hai woh hai tumhare phone pe kisi aur ka control. 26 August 2026 ko Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) ne advisory TAU/ADV/018 jaari ki. Isne warning di ki in dono platforms pe aise naamon se advertise kiye ja rahe nakli pornography apps se Android phones pe kabza kiya ja raha hai aur financial fraud ho raha hai [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]].

Jisne aisa app install kiya, woh fraud ka victim hai, offender nahi. Yeh guide batati hai ki jaal kaise kaam karta hai, use kaise pehchaanein, aur install dabane ke baad pehle ghante mein kya karna hai.

## Ad, download, kabza

Advisory ka title hi poori chain bata deta hai: "Malicious Side Loaded Pornographic Android Apps leading to Unauthorized Financial Transactions". Yeh "a rise in financial frauds perpetrated through malicious Android applications masquerading as pornography apps" report karti hai, yaani pornography apps ka bhes pehne malicious Android apps ke zariye badhte financial fraud, aur kuch aur naam ginati hai: "Vimo", "Rivo", "Nexo" aur "Vixa" [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. Naam badalte rahenge. Tareeka chaar chaalon mein chalta hai.

1. **Ad.** Yeh ek mainstream platform pe dikhta hai, jisse use woh bharosa mil jaata hai jo usne kamaya nahi.
2. **Download.** Link official app store nahi kholta. Woh ek installer file thama deta hai, aur Android tumse unknown source se install ki permission maangta hai. Isi ko side-loading kehte hain.
3. **Permission.** App accessibility access maangta hai, aur advisory kabze ko isi permission se jodti hai.
4. **Paisa.** Is control ke saath app ka use us cheez ke liye hota hai jise advisory unauthorised financial transactions kehti hai: tumhari approval ke bina tumhare account se paisa nikal jaata hai.

## Side-loaded apps khula darwaaza kyun hain

App store koi guarantee nahi hai, par ek checkpoint zaroor hai: wahan apps screen hote hain, aur users ke report karne pe hataye ja sakte hain. Side-loaded file is checkpoint ko skip kar deti hai.

Accessibility access doosra darwaaza hai. Yeh feature un logon ke liye hai jinhe dekhne ya haath chalane mein dikkat hai: yeh screen ko padh kar sunata hai ya unki jagah operate karta hai. Malicious app ke haath mein wahi taaqat tumhari screen pe jo bhi hai use padhne, aur aise tap aur type karne ke kaam aa sakti hai jaise tum khud kar rahe ho. Kisi video app ko iski zaroorat nahi hoti.

Chaara sexual hai; motive paisa hai. 2024 mein India ke 1,01,928 cyber crime cases mein se 73,987 mein, yaani 72.6% mein, motive fraud tha, jabki doosre sabse bade motive, sexual exploitation, ka hissa 3.1% tha [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]]. Yeh FIRs hain. Usi saal national cyber crime portal pe 22.68 lakh complaints aayi, aur portal ki zyada tar complaints financial fraud ki hoti hain [[ls-uq432-2025]].

Hamari samajh yeh hai: pornography achha chaara isliye banti hai kyunki jo ise leta hai, wahi kisi ko batane ki sabse kam sambhavna rakhta hai.

## 'Install' dabane se pehle ke red flags

- **Link app store se bahar le jaata hai.** "Download APK" button, ya unknown sources se install allow karne ka prompt, yahi ruk jaane ka signal hai.
- **App tumhe khud dhoondhne pe nahi milta.** Uska naam Play Store mein search karo. Agar wahan nahi hai, toh wahin se laut jao.
- **Woh bahut zyada maangta hai.** Accessibility access, SMS padhne ki permission aur device-admin rights ka video chalane se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
- **Woh tumse apni suraksha kam karne ko kehta hai.** Jo page Play Protect band karne ya security warning ignore karne ko kahe, woh khud bata raha hai ki woh kya hai.
- **Woh "Instagram pe tha".** Ad paise dekar li gayi jagah hai, safety check nahi [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]].

## Install ho chuka hai? Abhi kya karna hai

Socho Nagpur ka ek 19 saal ka ladka, jiske paas ghar ka purana phone hai aur usmein ab bhi uske papa ka UPI app pada hai. Woh aadhi raat ko inmein se ek app install karta hai; subah tak debit alerts aa chuke hote hain. Ab use sabse mehenga pad raha hai har woh ghanta jo woh yeh sochne mein laga raha hai ki kisi ko bata sakta hai ya nahi. Yahan sabse zyada farak speed se padta hai, isliye yeh steps isi order mein karo.

1. **Offline ho jao.** Aeroplane mode on karo, ya mobile data aur Wi-Fi band karo, taaki app apne operator tak na pahunch sake.
2. **Doosre phone se apne bank ko call karo.** Woh number use karo jo tumhare card ya passbook pe chhapa hai, search result wala nahi. Bank se cards, UPI aur net banking block karne ko kaho, aur complaint number note kar lo.
3. **Report karo.** 1930 pe call karo, jo toll-free cyber crime helpline hai, ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo, jo I4C ka chalaya hua portal hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]] [[cybercrime-portal]]. Transaction IDs taiyaar rakho.
4. **Saboot bachao.** Safai karne se pehle app ke naam aur icon ka, ad ya link ka, aur har transaction SMS ka screenshot le lo.
5. **App hatao.** Settings mein jaakar uska accessibility access aur koi bhi device-admin rights band karo, phir use uninstall karo. Agar woh na hate, toh photos aur contacts ka backup lekar phone factory-reset kar do.
6. **Kisi saaf device se passwords badlo.** Pehle banking aur UPI PIN, phir email, phir social media.

## Bina sharm ke report karna

Sexual chaare pe bana fraud chuppi pe chalta hai, aur sextortion yeh dikhata hai. Maharashtra Cyber ke ek senior police officer ne March 2022 ke ek op-ed mein andaaza lagaya ki India mein sextortion ke 0.5% se bhi kam cases FIR ke roop mein register hote hain, aur iski wajah sharm aur stigma batayi [[toi-yadav-sextortion-oped-2022]]. Yeh ek officer ka andaaza hai, ek alag crime ke baare mein, koi naapa hua rate nahi. Par mechanism wahi hai.

Teen baatein yeh call aasaan kar sakti hain. India mein kisi adult ke liye private mein adult pornography dekhna offence nahi hai; July 2015 mein Supreme Court ne kaha tha ki woh kisi adult ko apne kamre ki privacy mein ise dekhne se nahi rok sakta [[hindu-sc-adult-porn-privacy-2015]]. Tumhari complaint mein bas ek malicious app aur unauthorised transactions ke baare mein batana zaroori hai. Aur agar tum 18 se kam ho aur yeh ghar ke phone pe hua, tab bhi fraud tumhare saath hi hua hai: aaj hi mummy-papa ya kisi aur bharosemand adult ko batao, kyunki jo account khatre mein hai woh shayad unhi ka hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

Ho sakta hai report se paise wapas na aayein, aur courts dheeme hain: 2024 mein Indian courts ke saamne jo cyber crime cases the, unmein se 90.9% saal ke end tak pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Phir bhi report karo, aur jaldi karo. Block hua account agla transaction rok deta hai, aur record pe darj complaint hi woh cheez hai jis pe tumhara bank aur police action lete hain. App ke peeche baithe log isi bharose pe hain ki tum sharm ke maare call nahi karoge.

fake-profile-impersonation-takedown-guid.en:
Imagine a message from a friend: "Is this you? Why are you sending me requests from a new account?" You look, and the profile has your name and your photos, lifted from your own account and perhaps edited. It may be messaging your relatives, asking classmates for money, or sending requests to strangers in your name.

You do not need to wait for the police to get it removed. This guide sets out the order of steps. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Fake profile, real harm: what the numbers miss

In all of India, police registered 114 fake-profile cases against women in 2024, out of 18,615 cyber crimes against women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Compare that with a 2023 Snap survey of more than 6,000 teens and young adults in six countries including India, in which 65% said they or their friends had been targeted in online sextortion schemes through catfishing or hacking [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. That figure pools six countries, was commissioned by a platform and counts friends' experiences, so it is not an Indian rate. Even so, the two numbers are not on the same scale.

The police count is small for reasons that have little to do with how often this happens. A profile that is reported to the platform and removed never reaches a police register. NCRB counts each FIR once, under its most serious offence [[ncrb-cii-2024]], so a fake profile used for blackmail can be recorded as blackmail. And most of those 18,615 cases sit under a catch-all "other" heading. The fake profile is often the tool of the crime, and the tool is rarely counted.

## Step 1: document before you report

Once you report, the account may vanish, and your proof with it. First:

- Screenshot the profile page, its username, and every post that uses your photos.
- Copy the profile's link into a note. Display names change in seconds; links and usernames are what platforms and police need.
- Ask friends who received messages to screenshot them, with the date and time visible.
- Write down when you found the account and who told you.
- Do not message or threaten the account. A warned impersonator can delete it and start again under a new name.

One exception. If the profile carries sexual images of you taken when you were under 18, do not screenshot, download or forward them: Section 67B of the IT Act punishes collecting or exchanging such material [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Record the link instead.

## Step 2: the impersonation complaint and the two-hour clock

Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, 2021 covers content that exposes a person's private area, shows them nude or in a sexual act, or "is in the nature of impersonation in an electronic form, including artificially morphed images" of that person [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. An account that passes itself off as you, with your name, your photos or doctored versions of them, is the kind of content the clause describes. The complaint can come from you or from anyone on your behalf [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. No FIR is needed.

The clock is short. Since 20 February 2026, platforms must act within two hours of such a complaint, down from 24 [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Use the platform's impersonation report form, then say it in words: "This account impersonates me. I am the person in these photos. I am complaining under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, which requires removal within two hours." Paste every link. If the platform asks you to prove who you are, upload proof only through its official form, never to an account that messages you offering help. Note the exact time you filed.

## Step 3: grievance officer, then 1930

If the profile is still up after two hours, write to the platform's grievance officer with your links, the time of your first complaint and the rule. Ordinary grievances must now be resolved within seven days, down from 15 [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. A complaint that does not say "impersonation" may be put on that slower track, so name the rule every time.

Then use the state's channel. File at cybercrime.gov.in, the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal [[cybercrime-portal]], or call the toll-free helpline 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], and save the acknowledgement number. Know what that complaint is and is not: it gives you an official record, but a portal complaint is not an FIR. If you want a criminal case, report at any police station, whatever the area, or electronically; an electronic report is taken on record once you sign it within three days, and you must get a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## When a fake profile is a sign of something bigger

A fake profile is often the opening move of another crime.

**Stalking.** A man who builds accounts to watch a woman, or to reach her after she has blocked him, may be committing stalking under Section 78 of the BNS, punishable with up to three years in prison on a first conviction [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Our Q&A on Section 78 explains the law, and who it leaves out.

**Sextortion bait.** Your photos may be the face of someone else's scam. Financial sextortion mainly targets boys aged 13 to 17, who are typically deceived into believing they are talking to a young woman [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. If your pictures front such an account, warn your contacts from your real profile and report the account at once.

**Blackmail and morphing.** In 2024 police registered 370 cases of cyber blackmail or threats and 293 of defamation or morphing against women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Of 1,221 cyber blackmail and threat cases of all kinds before the courts that year, two ended in conviction [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The takedown can take two hours. The criminal case can take years. Run both, and never let the slow one hold up the fast one.
fake-profile-impersonation-takedown-guid.hg:
Socho, ek dost ka message aata hai: "Yeh tum ho? Naye account se mujhe requests kyun bhej rahe ho?" Tum dekhte ho, toh profile par tumhara naam hai aur tumhari photos, jo tumhare apne account se uthayi gayi hain aur shayad edit bhi ki gayi hain. Ho sakta hai woh account tumhare rishtedaaron ko message kar raha ho, classmates se paise maang raha ho, ya tumhare naam se anjaan logon ko requests bhej raha ho.

Ise hatwane ke liye police ka intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahin hai. Yeh guide steps ka sahi order batati hai. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahin.

## Fake profile, asli nuksaan: numbers kya nahin dikhate

Poore India mein police ne 2024 mein women ke khilaaf fake profile ke 114 cases darj kiye, women ke khilaaf kul 18,615 cyber crimes mein se [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Ab ise 2023 ke ek Snap survey ke saath rakh kar dekho: India samet chhe deshon ke 6,000 se zyada teens aur young adults mein se 65% ne kaha ki unhe ya unke doston ko catfishing ya hacking ke zariye online sextortion schemes mein target kiya gaya [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. Yeh figure chhe deshon ko milakar bana hai, survey ek platform ne karwaya tha, aur ismein doston ke experiences bhi gine gaye hain, isliye yeh India ka rate nahin hai. Phir bhi dono numbers ek hi scale ke nahin hain.

Police ki ginti chhoti hone ki wajah yeh nahin ki aisa kam hota hai. Jo profile platform par report hokar hat jaati hai, woh police ke register tak pahunchti hi nahin. NCRB har FIR ko ek hi baar ginta hai, uske sabse serious offence ke under [[ncrb-cii-2024]], toh blackmail ke liye istemaal hui fake profile blackmail mein gini ja sakti hai. Aur un 18,615 cases mein se zyadatar ek catch-all "other" heading mein pade hain. Fake profile aksar crime ka auzaar hoti hai, aur auzaar shayad hi kabhi gina jaata hai.

## Step 1: report karne se pehle saboot jama karo

Report karte hi account gayab ho sakta hai, aur uske saath tumhara saboot bhi. Isliye sabse pehle:

- Profile page, uske username, aur har us post ka screenshot lo jismein tumhari photos hain.
- Profile ka link ek note mein copy karo. Display name seconds mein badal jaate hain; platforms aur police ko link aur username chahiye.
- Jin doston ko messages aaye, unse kaho ki date aur time dikhte hue unka screenshot lein.
- Likh lo ki account tumhe kab mila aur kisne bataya.
- Account ko message mat karo, dhamki bhi mat do. Jise warning mil jaaye, woh account delete karke naye naam se phir shuru kar sakta hai.

Ek exception hai. Agar profile par tumhari aisi sexual images hain jo tab li gayi thin jab tumhari umar 18 se kam thi, toh unka screenshot mat lo, unhe download ya forward bhi mat karo: IT Act ka Section 67B aise material ko collect ya exchange karne par saza deta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Uski jagah sirf link record karo.

## Step 2: impersonation complaint aur do ghante ki ghadi

IT Rules, 2021 ka Rule 3(2)(b) us content par lagu hota hai jo kisi insaan ke private parts dikhata ho, use nude ya kisi sexual act mein dikhata ho, ya "is in the nature of impersonation in an electronic form, including artificially morphed images", yaani electronic roop mein us insaan ki nakal ho, morph ki gayi images samet [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. Jo account tumhara naam, tumhari photos ya unke edited versions lagakar khud ko tum batata hai, woh bilkul usi tarah ka content hai jiski baat yeh clause karta hai. Complaint tum khud kar sakte ho, ya tumhari taraf se koi bhi [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. FIR ki zaroorat nahin hai.

Ghadi chhoti hai. 20 February 2026 se platforms ko aisi complaint ke do ghante ke andar action lena hoga; pehle 24 ghante milte the [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Platform ka impersonation report form use karo, phir shabdon mein bhi likho: "This account impersonates me. I am the person in these photos. I am complaining under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, which requires removal within two hours." Yaani: yeh account meri nakal kar raha hai, photos mein main hoon, aur Rule 3(2)(b) ke under ise do ghante mein hatana zaroori hai. Har link paste karo. Agar platform tumse apni pehchaan saabit karne ko kahe, toh proof sirf uske official form se upload karo, kabhi us account ko mat bhejo jo "help" offer karte hue tumhe message kare. Complaint ka exact time note karo.

## Step 3: grievance officer, phir 1930

Agar do ghante baad bhi profile dikh rahi hai, toh platform ke grievance officer ko likho: tumhare links, pehli complaint ka time, aur rule ka naam. Aam grievances ab saat din mein suljhaani hongi; pehle 15 din the [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Jo complaint "impersonation" shabd nahin kehti, woh us dheemi line mein ja sakti hai, isliye har baar rule ka naam lo.

Phir sarkari raasta. National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, yaani cybercrime.gov.in, par complaint karo [[cybercrime-portal]], ya toll-free helpline 1930 par call karo [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], aur acknowledgement number save karo. Samjho ki yeh complaint kya hai aur kya nahin: isse tumhare paas ek official record ban jaata hai, lekin portal ki complaint FIR nahin hai. Agar criminal case chahiye, toh kisi bhi police station mein report karo, area chahe koi bhi ho, ya electronically; electronic report tab record par aati hai jab tum teen din ke andar us par sign kar do, aur FIR ki free copy tumhe milni hi chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Jab fake profile kisi badi cheez ka ishaara ho

Fake profile aksar kisi doosre crime ki pehli chaal hoti hai.

**Stalking.** Jo aadmi kisi woman par nazar rakhne ke liye, ya uske block karne ke baad bhi us tak pahunchne ke liye, naye accounts banata hai, woh BNS ke Section 78 ke under stalking kar raha ho sakta hai, jiski saza pehli conviction par teen saal tak ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Section 78 par hamara Q&A law samjhata hai, aur yeh bhi ki woh kise chhod deta hai.

**Sextortion ka chaara.** Ho sakta hai tumhari photos kisi aur ke scam ka chehra ban gayi hon. Financial sextortion zyadatar 13 se 17 saal ke ladkon ko target karta hai, jinhe aksar yeh yakeen dilaya jaata hai ki woh kisi young woman se baat kar rahe hain [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Agar tumhari tasveerein aise kisi account ka chehra hain, toh apni asli profile se contacts ko warn karo aur account ko turant report karo.

**Blackmail aur morphing.** 2024 mein police ne women ke khilaaf cyber blackmail ya dhamki ke 370 aur defamation ya morphing ke 293 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us saal court ke saamne har tarah ke cyber blackmail aur dhamki ke 1,221 cases mein se sirf do conviction par khatam hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Takedown mein do ghante lag sakte hain. Criminal case mein saal lag sakte hain. Dono saath chalao, aur dheeme raaste ko kabhi tez raaste ko rokne mat do.

first-hour-after-intimate-image-leak.en:
Imagine your phone buzzes at 11 at night. A cousin has sent a link and three words: "Is this you?" Maybe it is a photo you shared with one person, maybe your face on someone else's body. What you do in the next hour can limit how far it travels. Since 20 February 2026, platforms in India must remove nude, sexual or morphed images of a person within two hours of that person's complaint, down from 24 hours [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. You do not need the police or a court for that. Here is the hour, step by step. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Minutes 0–10: stop, breathe, save the evidence

Do not reply, argue or plead. Do not forward the link to friends to ask if they have seen it; every forward spreads it further. And do not delete your own chats or account in panic. They are evidence.

Instead, make a record. For every place the image appears, note the link, the account name or phone number, the platform, and the date and time you saw it. Screenshot the page with the account name and link visible, and any message or demand that came with it. Keep all of it in one note on your phone.

One exception matters. If the image was taken when you were under 18, do not download, screenshot or forward it at all. Section 67B of the IT Act punishes collecting, downloading or exchanging sexual material depicting children [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Write down the links instead.

## Minutes 10–30: report to every platform under the two-hour rule

The rule you are using is Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, 2021. It covers content that exposes a person's private area, shows them fully or partly nude or in a sexual act, or impersonates them, including artificially morphed images. The complaint can come from you or from any person acting on your behalf [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. If you cannot bear to look at it again, a friend can file for you.

Use each platform's report option for nudity or non-consensual intimate images, and report every link separately. Wherever there is a box for details, paste something like this:

> I am the person shown in this content: [link]. It shows me [nude / partly nude / in a sexual act / in a morphed image] and was shared without my consent. Under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, 2021, please remove or disable access to it within two hours of this complaint and confirm when it is done.

Note the time of each report; the two-hour clock starts there. If a post is still up after two hours, that note starts your escalation; our two-hour-rule explainer covers it.

## Minutes 30–45: hash it with StopNCII or Take It Down

A takedown removes one copy. A hash, a digital fingerprint of the image, helps stop the next one. Your age in the image decides the tool. For images taken at 18 or older, use StopNCII.org. For images taken under 18, use Take It Down, which is free, anonymous and available in Hindi, and sends participating platforms only the fingerprint, never the image [[ncmec-take-it-down]].

You are far from the first: StopNCII had supported over 785,000 cases by November 2025, and only its partner platforms act on its fingerprints [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]]. Take It Down works only on public or unencrypted platforms that take part, so private encrypted chats are out of its reach [[ncmec-take-it-down]]. Both tools fingerprint a copy already on your own device: if the image was taken when you were under 18, never download a fresh copy to use them. Never send the image to anyone who offers to "get it removed" for money. Our StopNCII and Take It Down guide has the steps.

## Minutes 45–60: call 1930 and tell one person you trust

Call 1930, India's toll-free cyber crime helpline, or file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in, the national portal run by the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. Under the Ministry of Electronics and IT's November 2025 procedure on non-consensual intimate imagery, I4C collects such complaints and keeps a secure hash bank of these images [[pib-meity-ncii-sop-2025]]. A complaint there reaches the agency that keeps that hash bank. Save any reference number the portal gives you [[cybercrime-portal]].

Then tell one person who will stay calm and keep it private: a friend, sibling or cousin. Not a group chat. One person can sit with you, hold the evidence note and file reports on your behalf. If you are under 18, tell an adult you trust or call the Child Helpline 1098, which runs 24x7 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. An adult who learns of it, such as a teacher, may be bound by the POCSO Act to inform the police [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]; that duty exists to protect children.

## After the first hour: the police complaint and your mind

Sharing the image is a crime even if you agreed to the photo. For women, Section 77 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) makes it voyeurism, with one to three years in prison on a first conviction [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. For anyone, of any gender, the IT Act's Sections 66E and 67A apply [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Under Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), you can report at any police station, wherever the offence happened (a Zero FIR), or send the complaint electronically and sign it within three days. You must get a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A woman's complaint of voyeurism must be recorded by a woman officer. Know one catch: for offences punishable with three to under seven years, police may, with a Deputy Superintendent's permission, hold a preliminary enquiry of up to 14 days before registering the case, and voyeurism may fall in that window [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. That is why the takedown, which needs no FIR, comes first.

Then there is your mind. If panic keeps returning with every notification, that is a normal response to a violation, not weakness. Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 [[tele-manas]], the Health Ministry's free counselling line, open round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Whatever the image shows, the crime belongs to the person who shared it.
first-hour-after-intimate-image-leak.hg:
Socho, raat ke 11 baje tumhara phone bajta hai. Kisi cousin ne ek link bheja hai aur bas teen shabd: "Yeh tum ho?" Shayad yeh woh photo hai jo tumne sirf ek insaan ko bheji thi, ya shayad kisi aur ki body pe tumhara chehra laga diya gaya hai. Agle ek ghante mein tum jo karoge, usse iska phailna kam ho sakta hai. 20 February 2026 se India mein platforms ko kisi ki nude, sexual ya morphed images us insaan ki complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar hatani hoti hain; pehle yeh time 24 ghante tha [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Iske liye na police chahiye, na court. Yeh raha poora ghanta, step by step. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Minute 0–10: ruko, saans lo, evidence bachao

Reply mat karo, behas mat karo, minnat mat karo. Doston ko link bhejke mat poochho ki unhone dekha ya nahi; har forward ise aur door tak phailata hai. Aur ghabrahat mein apni chats ya account delete mat karo. Yeh evidence hain.

Iske bajaye sab record karo. Jahan-jahan image dikhi hai, har jagah ka link, account name ya phone number, platform, aur date aur time note karo. Page ka aisa screenshot lo jisme account name aur link dikhe, aur saath aaya koi message ya demand bhi. Sab kuch apne phone ke ek hi note mein rakho.

Ek exception bahut important hai. Agar image tab li gayi thi jab tum 18 se chhote the, toh use download, screenshot ya forward bilkul mat karo. IT Act ka Section 67B bachchon se jude sexual material ko collect, download ya exchange karne ko bhi punish karta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Bas links likh lo.

## Minute 10–30: har platform pe 2-ghante wale rule ke under report karo

Tum jo rule use kar rahe ho, woh hai IT Rules, 2021 ka Rule 3(2)(b). Yeh aise content pe laagu hota hai jo kisi ka private area expose kare, kisi ko poora ya aadha nude ya sexual act mein dikhaye, ya kisi ka impersonation kare, artificially morphed images samet. Complaint tum khud kar sakte ho, ya tumhari taraf se koi bhi [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. Agar use dobara dekhne ki himmat nahi ho rahi, toh koi dost tumhare liye file kar sakta hai.

Har platform pe nudity ya non-consensual intimate image wala report option use karo, aur har link alag se report karo. Jahan bhi details ka box ho, wahan kuch aisa paste karo:

> I am the person shown in this content: [link]. It shows me [nude / partly nude / in a sexual act / in a morphed image] and was shared without my consent. Under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, 2021, please remove or disable access to it within two hours of this complaint and confirm when it is done.

Har report ka time note karo; 2 ghante ki ghadi wahin se shuru hoti hai. Agar 2 ghante baad bhi post upar hai, toh wahi note tumhare escalation ki shuruaat hai; 2-ghante wale rule pe hamara explainer iske baare mein batata hai.

## Minute 30–45: StopNCII ya Take It Down se hash banao

Takedown se ek copy hatti hai. Hash, yaani image ka digital fingerprint, agli copy ko rokne mein help karta hai. Image mein tumhari umar kya thi, usse tool decide hota hai. 18 ya usse zyada umar mein li gayi image ke liye StopNCII.org use karo. 18 se kam umar ki image ke liye Take It Down hai, jo free hai, anonymous hai, Hindi mein bhi hai, aur participating platforms ko sirf fingerprint bhejta hai, image kabhi nahi [[ncmec-take-it-down]].

Tum pehle insaan nahi ho jo yeh kar rahe ho: November 2025 tak StopNCII 785,000 se zyada cases mein support kar chuka tha, aur uske fingerprints pe sirf uske partner platforms hi action lete hain [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]]. Take It Down sirf un public ya unencrypted platforms pe kaam karta hai jo isse jude hain, isliye private encrypted chats uski pahunch se bahar hain [[ncmec-take-it-down]]. Dono tools usi copy ka fingerprint banate hain jo pehle se tumhare apne device pe hai: agar image tab li gayi thi jab tum 18 se chhote the, toh tool use karne ke liye nayi copy kabhi download mat karo. Jo bhi paise leke image "hatwane" ka offer de, use image kabhi mat bhejo. StopNCII aur Take It Down pe hamari guide mein saare steps hain.

## Minute 45–60: 1930 pe call karo aur ek trusted insaan ko batao

1930 pe call karo, jo India ki toll-free cyber crime helpline hai, ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo, jo Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) ka national portal hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. Electronics aur IT Ministry (MeitY) ke November 2025 wale non-consensual intimate imagery SOP ke under, aisi complaints I4C collect karta hai, aur wahi in images ka ek secure hash bank rakhta hai [[pib-meity-ncii-sop-2025]]. Matlab wahan ki gayi complaint usi agency tak pahunchti hai jo yeh hash bank rakhti hai. Portal jo bhi reference number de, use sambhaal ke rakho [[cybercrime-portal]].

Phir kisi ek aise insaan ko batao jo shaant rahe aur baat apne tak rakhe: koi dost, bhai-behen ya cousin. Group chat mein nahi. Ek insaan tumhare saath baith sakta hai, evidence wala note sambhaal sakta hai, aur tumhari taraf se reports file kar sakta hai. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya Child Helpline 1098 pe call karo, jo 24x7 chalti hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Jis adult ko iska pata chale, jaise koi teacher, use POCSO Act ke under police ko batana pad sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]; yeh duty bachchon ki suraksha ke liye hai.

## Pehle ghante ke baad: police complaint aur tumhara mann

Image share karna crime hai, chahe tumne photo ke liye haan kaha ho. Women ke case mein Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 77 ise voyeurism maanta hai, jisme pehli conviction pe 1 se 3 saal ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Kisi bhi gender ke insaan ke liye IT Act ke Sections 66E aur 67A laagu hote hain [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 173 ke under tum kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte ho, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), ya complaint online bhejke 3 din ke andar sign kar sakte ho. FIR ki copy tumhe free milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Kisi woman ki voyeurism wali complaint woman officer hi record karegi. Ek catch bhi jaan lo: jin offences mein 3 saal ya usse zyada, lekin 7 saal se kam ki saza hai, unme police DSP ki permission se case register karne se pehle 14 din tak preliminary enquiry kar sakti hai, aur voyeurism is window mein aa sakta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Isiliye takedown pehle karo, kyunki uske liye FIR ki zarurat hi nahi.

Ab baat tumhare mann ki. Agar har notification ke saath panic laut aata hai, toh yeh kamzori nahi, kisi violation pe ek normal reaction hai. Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo [[tele-manas]]. Yeh Health Ministry ki free counselling line hai jo 24 ghante khuli rehti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Image mein jo bhi dikhe, crime uska hai jisne use share kiya.

image-abuse-law-men-trans-people.en:
Consider three people in one city, all hypothetical. A woman's former boyfriend forwards a private photo she once sent him. A man's former partner does the same with his. A trans woman is secretly filmed in a changing room, and the clip lands in a WhatsApp group. The violation is the same each time. The law is not: the criminal code's main offence for it clearly protects only the first of them. Here is what the other two can use. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Who BNS Section 77 protects, and who it leaves out

Section 77 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), the voyeurism offence, makes it a crime to share a private image of a woman without her consent, even if she agreed to the image being taken. The punishment is 1 to 3 years in prison on first conviction and 3 to 7 years on a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

The image has to be of a woman. The BNS defines a "woman" as "a female human being of any age" and a "man" as a male one [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. So a man whose intimate image is leaked has no case under Section 77, and the code does not say whether a trans woman counts as a woman.

The people left out are not rare. When the Canadian Centre for Child Protection analysed more than 6,500 public first-hand accounts by victims of sexual extortion, 98% were male where gender could be identified, WeProtect reported in 2023 [[weprotect-gta-2023]]. Those posts are self-selected, not a survey, but WeProtect also finds that sextortion for money mainly targets boys aged 13 to 17 [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Until 18, a boy is covered by POCSO, which protects every child [[pocso-act-2012]]. After that, Section 77 does not take over.

## The 'gender-neutral' claim against the text

In July 2024, the Home Ministry said in a note on the new criminal laws that "various offences against women and children have been made gender-neutral in BNS, covering all victims and perpetrators regardless of gender", and that the definition of gender "now includes transgender individuals" [[pib-new-criminal-laws-2024]].

The text is narrower. The BNS does say the pronoun "he" covers any person, "whether male, female or transgender". But its sexual offences are still built on "man" and "woman": by their wording, sexual harassment (Section 75) and stalking (Section 78) can be committed only by a man, and Section 77 protects only a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

The Supreme Court has said it cannot close the gap itself. On 14 October 2024 the Supreme Court refused to entertain a plea to make sexual offences against men and transgender persons crimes under the BNS, saying it cannot direct Parliament to create an offence [[livelaw-sc-bns-sexual-offences-men-pil-2024]].

## The laws that do cover everyone

The Information Technology Act, 2000 does not sort victims by gender.

- **Section 66E** punishes whoever "captures, publishes or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent". The penalty is up to 3 years in prison, a fine of up to Rs 2 lakh, or both [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Like Section 77, it turns on consent. Unlike it, it has no minimum sentence: a conviction can end in a fine alone. Police registered 436 cases under it in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].
- **Sections 67 and 67A** punish publishing obscene material online (up to 3 years and Rs 5 lakh on first conviction) and sexually explicit material (up to 5 years and Rs 10 lakh) [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. They apply whoever is in the image.
- **The takedown rule** is neutral too. Since 20 February 2026, a platform must remove nude, sexual or morphed images of a person within two hours of that person's complaint [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

## Transgender survivors: Section 18's low ceiling

Transgender people have one more provision, and it is weak. Section 18(d) of the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act punishes harming or endangering a transgender person's safety or well-being, in a list that runs "physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal and emotional abuse and economic abuse". The penalty for all of it is 6 months to 2 years in prison and a fine [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]], a lower maximum than a first conviction for leaking a woman's photo carries.

Parliament rewrote Section 18 in 2026 and left that range unchanged, while adding a new offence that carries 10 years to life: kidnapping an adult and causing grievous hurt to force a transgender identity on them [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

The same amendment narrowed the Act's definition of a transgender person, which now excludes "persons with different sexual orientations and self-perceived sexual identities" [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. The Supreme Court heard challenges to the amendment on 17 August 2026 [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]]. As the law stands, a trans woman whom police do not treat as a "woman" under the BNS, and who falls outside the new definition, could find neither special provision applied to her. The IT Act still applies.

## What to cite in a complaint

If someone at a police station says "that section is only for women", they are right about Section 77 and wrong that nothing applies.

- **An adult man:** IT Act Section 66E for capturing or sharing the image, and Section 67 or 67A if it was posted or forwarded.
- **A transgender person:** the same sections, plus Section 18(d) of the Transgender Persons Act.
- **Anyone under 18:** POCSO and IT Act Section 67B, whatever the child's gender.

Name the sections in your complaint at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], or at any police station, where you must be given a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Report every copy to the platform too, and remember that a threat to leak can be reported before anything is shared. If the fear or shame gets too heavy, Tele-MANAS on 14416 offers free counselling round the clock to anyone, including transgender persons [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

The repair is simple: write Section 77 for "any person", as Section 66E already is, and every survivor gets the same offence and the same minimum sentence. Only Parliament can do that. Until it does, you may have to be the one who names the sections that exist.
image-abuse-law-men-trans-people.hg:
Ek hi sheher ke teen logon ke baare mein sochiye; teeno hypothetical hain. Ek woman ka former boyfriend woh private photo forward kar deta hai jo usne kabhi use bheji thi. Ek man ka former partner uski photo ke saath yahi karta hai. Ek trans woman ko changing room mein chhup kar film kiya jaata hai, aur clip ek WhatsApp group mein pahunch jaati hai. Teeno baar violation ek hi hai. Law ek nahi hai: is harkat ke liye criminal code ka jo main offence hai, woh in teeno mein se saaf taur par sirf pehli ko protect karta hai. Baaki do kya use kar sakte hain, yeh yahan hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## BNS Section 77 kise protect karta hai, aur kise chhod deta hai

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 77, yaani voyeurism ka offence, kisi woman ki private image uske consent ke bina share karne ko crime banata hai, chahe image lene ke liye woh raazi rahi ho. Saza pehli conviction par 1 se 3 saal ki jail hai, aur dobara conviction par 3 se 7 saal [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Image ek woman ki honi chahiye. BNS "woman" ko "a female human being of any age" kehta hai, aur "man" ko kisi bhi umar ka male [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Isliye jis man ki intimate image leak hui, uska Section 77 ke tahat koi case nahi banta, aur code yeh nahi batata ki trans woman ko woman gina jaayega ya nahi.

Jo log chhoot jaate hain, woh kam nahi hain. Canadian Centre for Child Protection ne sexual extortion ke victims ke 6,500 se zyada public first-hand accounts ka analysis kiya; jahan gender pehchana ja saka, unme 98% male the, WeProtect ne 2023 mein report kiya [[weprotect-gta-2023]]. Yeh posts self-selected hain, koi survey nahi, lekin WeProtect yeh bhi kehta hai ki paise ke liye hone wala sextortion mainly 13 se 17 saal ke boys ko target karta hai [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. 18 saal tak ek boy POCSO ke daayre mein hai, jo har child ko protect karta hai [[pocso-act-2012]]. Uske baad Section 77 uski jagah nahi leta.

## 'Gender-neutral' ka daava aur law ka text

July 2024 mein Home Ministry ne naye criminal laws par ek note mein kaha ki "various offences against women and children have been made gender-neutral in BNS, covering all victims and perpetrators regardless of gender", aur yeh ki gender ki definition mein "now includes transgender individuals" [[pib-new-criminal-laws-2024]].

Text is daave se chhota hai. BNS yeh zaroor kehta hai ki pronoun "he" har person ko cover karta hai, "whether male, female or transgender". Lekin iske sexual offences abhi bhi "man" aur "woman" shabdon par hi khade hain: wording ke hisaab se sexual harassment (Section 75) aur stalking (Section 78) sirf ek man hi kar sakta hai, aur Section 77 sirf ek woman ko protect karta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki yeh gap woh khud nahi bhar sakta. 14 October 2024 ko Supreme Court ne us plea ko sunne se inkaar kar diya jisme men aur transgender persons ke khilaf sexual offences ko BNS ke tahat crime banane ki maang thi; court ne kaha ki woh Parliament ko koi offence banane ka direction nahi de sakti [[livelaw-sc-bns-sexual-offences-men-pil-2024]].

## Woh laws jo sabko cover karte hain

Information Technology Act, 2000 victims ko gender ke hisaab se nahi baantta.

- **Section 66E** us har insaan ko saza deta hai jo "captures, publishes or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent". Penalty hai 3 saal tak ki jail, Rs 2 lakh tak ka fine, ya dono [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Section 77 ki tarah yeh bhi consent par tika hai. Farak yeh hai ki isme koi minimum sentence nahi hai: conviction sirf fine par bhi khatam ho sakti hai. 2024 mein police ne iske tahat 436 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]].
- **Sections 67 aur 67A** online obscene material publish karne par (pehli conviction par 3 saal tak aur Rs 5 lakh) aur sexually explicit material publish karne par (5 saal tak aur Rs 10 lakh) saza dete hain [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Image mein kaun hai, isse inke lagne par koi farak nahi padta.
- **Takedown rule** bhi neutral hai. 20 February 2026 se platform ko kisi bhi person ki nude, sexual ya morphed images us person ki complaint ke do ghante ke andar hatani hoti hain [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

## Transgender survivors: Section 18 ki neechi ceiling

Transgender logon ke paas ek provision aur hai, aur woh kamzor hai. Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act ka Section 18(d) kisi transgender person ki safety ya well-being ko nuksaan pahunchane ya khatre mein daalne par saza deta hai, aur iski list hai: "physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal and emotional abuse and economic abuse". In sabki penalty 6 mahine se 2 saal ki jail aur fine hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Yeh maximum us maximum se kam hai jo ek woman ki photo leak karne ki pehli conviction par milta hai.

Parliament ne 2026 mein Section 18 dobara likha aur is range ko waise hi chhod diya, jabki ek naya offence joda jisme 10 saal se lekar life tak ki saza hai: kisi adult ko kidnap karke aur grievous hurt pahuncha kar us par transgender identity thopna [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

Isi amendment ne Act mein transgender person ki definition bhi chhoti kar di, jo ab "persons with different sexual orientations and self-perceived sexual identities" ko bahar rakhti hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Supreme Court ne 17 August 2026 ko is amendment ke khilaf challenges sune [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]]. Abhi ke law mein, jis trans woman ko police BNS ke tahat "woman" nahi maanti aur jo nayi definition ke bahar bhi reh jaati hai, uske case mein ho sakta hai ki dono mein se koi bhi special provision na lage. IT Act phir bhi lagta hai.

## Complaint mein kya cite karein

Agar police station mein koi kahe ki "yeh section toh sirf women ke liye hai", toh Section 77 ke baare mein woh sahi hai, lekin yeh galat hai ki kuch bhi nahi lagta.

- **Ek adult man:** image lene ya share karne ke liye IT Act Section 66E, aur agar image post ya forward hui ho toh Section 67 ya 67A.
- **Ek transgender person:** yahi sections, aur saath mein Transgender Persons Act ka Section 18(d).
- **18 se kam umar ka koi bhi:** POCSO aur IT Act Section 67B, child ka gender chahe jo ho.

Apni complaint mein in sections ke naam likhiye, cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], ya kisi bhi police station mein, jahan aapko FIR ki free copy milni hi chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Har copy platform ko bhi report kijiye, aur yaad rakhiye ki leak karne ki dhamki ki report tab bhi ho sakti hai jab kuch share nahi hua. Agar darr ya sharam bahut bhaari lagne lage, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par chaubees ghante free counselling deta hai, har kisi ko, transgender persons ko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Ilaaj seedha hai: Section 77 ko "any person" ke liye likh diya jaaye, jaise Section 66E pehle se hai, toh har survivor ko wahi offence aur wahi minimum sentence milega. Yeh sirf Parliament kar sakti hai. Jab tak woh nahi karti, ho sakta hai ki jo sections maujood hain, unka naam aapko khud lena pade.

india-deepfake-rules-2026-explained.en:
Imagine a second-year student in Bhopal who opens her class group and finds a nude image of herself that she never took: her face, someone else's body, stitched together by an app. The image is fake. What it does to her is not. It could as easily be a young man or a trans person.

Since 2021, India's IT Rules have let a person demand the removal of "artificially morphed images" of them [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]]. What they did not do was define AI-made media, or tell platforms that offer AI tools what those tools must refuse to make. The IT Amendment Rules, 2026, notified on 10 February and in force since 20 February, do both [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

## What the law now calls a deepfake

The legal term is not "deepfake" but "synthetically generated information", defined in Rule 2(1)(wa): audio, visual or audio-visual content artificially or algorithmically created, generated, modified or altered using a computer resource, so that it appears real, authentic or true, and depicts a person or event in a way that is, or is likely to be perceived as, indistinguishable from a real person or real-world event [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Routine or good-faith editing, accessibility features and good-faith document creation are carved out.

Read it as a three-part test: made or changed by a machine, looks real, and shows a person or event as if it happened. A face-swapped nude passes all three. A brightness fix does not, and nor does an obvious cartoon. A cloned voice can, because the definition covers audio.

## Two duties for AI tools: block or label

The heaviest duties fall on platforms that offer AI tools to create or alter content [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]:

- **Block.** They must deploy technical measures so that users cannot create synthetic content containing child sexual exploitative and abuse material or non-consensual intimate imagery.
