The figure is pooled and counts friends, so it shows how common the attempt is, not an Indian rate.

In the usual sextortion racket, a fake profile, often posing as a woman, video-calls the target, records the call and uses the recording for blackmail. Police in Rajasthan's Alwar district caught more than 60 such gangs in the year to September 2021 [[bhaskar-alwar-sextortion-2021]]. In August 2026 the government's cyber crime centre, I4C, warned that fake pornography apps advertised on Facebook and Instagram were being used to take over Android phones and commit financial fraud [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. And police recorded 114 cases of fake profiles and 293 of defamation or morphing against women in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Those are FIR counts, a small part of what happens.

Each attack needs you to open a door: answer a call, type a code, tap "install". Settings keep the doors shut by default, so that one tired, lonely or curious moment is not enough.

## Calls and messages: who can reach you

- **WhatsApp:** open Settings, then Privacy. Turn on "Silence unknown callers". Set profile photo, last seen and "About" to "My contacts", and set Groups so that only contacts can add you.
- **Instagram:** make the account private unless you need it public. That also hides your follower list, which a blackmailer can use to threaten to message your family. Limit message requests, tags and mentions to people you follow.
- **Telegram and Snapchat:** hide your phone number and allow calls only from contacts or friends.

Then the rule no setting can enforce: never answer a video call from someone you have not met. In sextortion for money, the move from first message to coercion can take minutes to hours [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]].

## Accounts: two-step verification and recovery

A password alone can be guessed, leaked or tricked out of you. Turn on two-step verification in this order:

1. **Your email.** Every other account sends its password reset there.
2. **WhatsApp.** Settings, Account, Two-step verification: set a PIN and add a recovery email.
3. **Instagram, Snapchat and any app that holds private chats or photos.**

Where offered, use an authenticator app or a passkey instead of SMS codes. Never read out or forward a code. A WhatsApp code you did not ask for can mean someone is trying to register your number on their phone.

Next, open "Linked devices" in WhatsApp and the device list in Instagram and your Google or Apple account. Log out anything you don't recognise or no longer control, such as an ex-partner's laptop. Hide message content on the lock screen, so a code cannot be read off a locked phone.

If an account is taken over, move fast: change the email password first, use "log out of all devices", check that the recovery phone and email are still yours, and warn your contacts not to trust messages sent in your name.

## Apps: installs, permissions and side-loading

The apps in the I4C warning reached people through advertisements, under names such as "Night Play", "Reloop" and "Kyss" [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. Installing an app from a link or a downloaded file, outside the official store, is called side-loading. It skips the store's checks, and Android blocks it unless you allow it.

- **Keep it blocked.** In Android Settings, search for "Install unknown apps" and set every app, including your browser and WhatsApp, to "Not allowed". Keep Google Play Protect on.
- **Check Accessibility.** In Settings, open Accessibility and look at the downloaded apps listed. An app with this permission can read your screen and tap buttons for you, even in your banking app. Remove any you don't recognise.
- **Audit permissions.** Give camera, microphone, location, contacts and photos only to apps that need them, and "only while using the app".
- **On an iPhone,** never install a "profile" because a website or a stranger asks.

## Photos and location: what syncs where

A private image is only as private as every device it copies itself to.

- **Know your backup.** In Google Photos or iCloud, check which account your photos back up to, who else is signed in to it, and whether partner sharing or a shared album is on. A family tablet on the same account shows everything.
- **Stop auto-saving.** In WhatsApp, turn off "Media visibility" (Android) or "Save to Photos" (iPhone), so received images don't land in your gallery and the cloud.
- **Lock what is private.** Use the locked folder on Android or the hidden album with Face ID on an iPhone, and check whether it backs up.
- **Check location.** See who can follow you on Google Maps location sharing, Find My, Snap Map and WhatsApp live location, and switch off location tags in the camera. Sharing location is a choice you can withdraw.

If something still gets through, it is not your fault, and paying is not the way out. In a study cited by WeProtect in its 2024 brief on sextortion of young people, 70% of victims who ignored payment demands did not have their images distributed [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Save the evidence, then call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. If a nude, sexual or morphed image of you is posted, complain to the platform: since 20 February 2026 it has two hours to remove it [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Last item on the audit: save 1930 in your contacts now.
phone-privacy-settings-safety-audit.hg:
Imagine kijiye: Indore ka ek 19 saal ka student, aadhi neend mein, ek naye follower ka video call utha leta hai. Kuch bhi hack nahi hua. Phone ne wahi kiya jo uski default settings allow karti hain: ek stranger call kar saka, theek waise hi jaise ek advertisement aapko install karne ke liye app thama sakta hai, aur ek private photo khud ko family tablet par copy kar sakti hai. Blackmail ya khaali bank account par khatam hone wale kai attacks aise hi shuru hote hain. Yeh audit un darwazon ko ek hi baithak mein band karta hai, lagbhag aadhe ghante mein.

## Woh attacks jinka saamna aapko sach mein ho sakta hai

2023 ke ek Snap survey mein, jisme India samet chhe deshon ke 6,000 se zyada teens aur young adults shaamil the, 65% ne kaha ki unhe ya unke friends ko catfishing ya hacking ke zariye sextortion schemes mein target kiya gaya [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. Yeh figure sab deshon ka mila-jula hai aur isme friends bhi gine gaye hain, isliye yeh dikhata hai ki koshish kitni common hai, India ka rate nahi.

Aam sextortion racket mein ek fake profile, jo aksar ek woman ban kar aati hai, target ko video call karti hai, call record karti hai aur us recording se blackmail karti hai. Rajasthan ke Alwar district ki police ne September 2021 tak ke ek saal mein aise 60 se zyada gangs pakde [[bhaskar-alwar-sextortion-2021]]. August 2026 mein sarkar ke cyber crime centre, I4C, ne warning di ki Facebook aur Instagram par advertise hone wale fake pornography apps ka istemaal Android phones ko take over karne aur financial fraud karne ke liye ho raha hai [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. Aur 2024 mein police ne women ke khilaf fake profile ke 114 cases aur defamation ya morphing ke 293 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh FIRs ki ginti hai, jo asal mein hone wali ghatnaon ka chhota sa hissa hai.

Har attack ko zaroorat hoti hai ki darwaza aap kholein: call uthayein, code type karein, "install" par tap karein. Settings in darwazon ko default se band rakhti hain, taaki thakaan, akelepan ya curiosity ka ek pal kaafi na ho.

## Calls aur messages: aap tak kaun pahunch sakta hai

- **WhatsApp:** Settings kholiye, phir Privacy. "Silence unknown callers" on kijiye. Profile photo, last seen aur "About" ko "My contacts" par set kijiye, aur Groups aise set kijiye ki sirf contacts hi aapko add kar sakein.
- **Instagram:** account private rakhiye, jab tak aapko public account ki zaroorat na ho. Isse aapki follower list bhi chhup jaati hai, jiska istemaal karke koi blackmailer aapki family ko message karne ki dhamki de sakta hai. Message requests, tags aur mentions sirf un logon tak limit kijiye jinhe aap follow karte hain.
- **Telegram aur Snapchat:** apna phone number hide kijiye aur calls sirf contacts ya friends se allow kijiye.

Phir woh rule jo koi setting enforce nahi kar sakti: jisse aap kabhi mile nahi, uska video call kabhi mat uthaiye. Paise ke liye hone wale sextortion mein pehle message se coercion tak ka safar minutes se lekar ghanton mein tay ho sakta hai [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]].

## Accounts: two-step verification aur recovery

Sirf password guess ho sakta hai, leak ho sakta hai, ya baaton mein phansa kar aapse nikalwaya ja sakta hai. Two-step verification is order mein on kijiye:

1. **Aapka email.** Baaki har account apna password reset wahin bhejta hai.
2. **WhatsApp.** Settings, Account, Two-step verification: ek PIN set kijiye aur recovery email add kijiye.
3. **Instagram, Snapchat aur har woh app jisme private chats ya photos hain.**

Jahan option mile, SMS codes ki jagah authenticator app ya passkey use kijiye. Code kabhi kisi ko padh kar mat sunaiye, na forward kijiye. Agar WhatsApp ka aisa code aaye jo aapne maanga hi nahi, toh ho sakta hai koi aapka number apne phone par register karne ki koshish kar raha ho.

Iske baad WhatsApp mein "Linked devices" kholiye, aur Instagram aur apne Google ya Apple account mein device list dekhiye. Jo device aap nahi pehchante ya jo ab aapke control mein nahi hai, jaise kisi ex-partner ka laptop, use log out kar dijiye. Lock screen par message content hide kijiye, taaki locked phone se code na padha ja sake.

Agar koi account take over ho jaaye, toh tezi se kaam kijiye: sabse pehle email ka password badliye, "log out of all devices" use kijiye, check kijiye ki recovery phone aur email abhi bhi aapke hi hain, aur apne contacts ko bata dijiye ki aapke naam se aaye messages par bharosa na karein.

## Apps: installs, permissions aur side-loading

I4C ki warning wale apps logon tak advertisements ke zariye pahunche, "Night Play", "Reloop" aur "Kyss" jaise naamon se [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. Official store ke bahar, kisi link ya download ki hui file se app install karne ko side-loading kehte hain. Isme store ke checks skip ho jaate hain, aur Android ise tab tak block rakhta hai jab tak aap khud allow na karein.

- **Ise blocked hi rakhiye.** Android Settings mein "Install unknown apps" search kijiye aur har app ko, apne browser aur WhatsApp ko bhi, "Not allowed" par set kijiye. Google Play Protect on rakhiye.
- **Accessibility check kijiye.** Settings mein Accessibility kholiye aur wahan listed downloaded apps dekhiye. Jis app ke paas yeh permission hai, woh aapki screen padh sakta hai aur aapki jagah buttons tap kar sakta hai, aapke banking app mein bhi. Jise aap nahi pehchante, use hata dijiye.
- **Permissions ka audit kijiye.** Camera, microphone, location, contacts aur photos sirf un apps ko dijiye jinhe inki zaroorat hai, aur woh bhi "only while using the app".
- **iPhone par** koi "profile" sirf isliye install mat kijiye ki kisi website ya stranger ne kaha hai.

## Photos aur location: kya kahan sync hota hai

Ek private image utni hi private rehti hai jitne private woh saare devices hain jahan woh copy hoti hai.

- **Apna backup jaaniye.** Google Photos ya iCloud mein check kijiye ki aapki photos kis account par back up hoti hain, us account mein aur kaun signed in hai, aur partner sharing ya koi shared album on toh nahi. Usi account wala family tablet sab kuch dikhata hai.
- **Auto-save band kijiye.** WhatsApp mein "Media visibility" (Android) ya "Save to Photos" (iPhone) off kijiye, taaki aayi hui images aapki gallery aur cloud mein na pahunchein.
- **Jo private hai use lock kijiye.** Android par locked folder ya iPhone par Face ID wala hidden album use kijiye, aur check kijiye ki woh back up hota hai ya nahi.
- **Location check kijiye.** Dekhiye ki Google Maps location sharing, Find My, Snap Map aur WhatsApp live location par aapko kaun follow kar sakta hai, aur camera mein location tags off kijiye. Location share karna aapki choice hai, jise aap kabhi bhi wapas le sakte hain.

Agar phir bhi kuch ho jaaye, toh yeh aapki galti nahi hai, aur pay karna iska raasta nahi hai. WeProtect ki 2024 ki young logon ke sextortion par brief mein cite ki gayi ek study ke mutabik, payment demands ko ignore karne wale 70% victims ki images distribute nahi hui [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Evidence save kijiye, phir 1930 par call kijiye ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint kijiye [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. Agar aapki koi nude, sexual ya morphed image post ho jaaye, toh platform se complaint kijiye: 20 February 2026 se use hatane ke liye platform ke paas do ghante hain [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Audit ka aakhri item: 1930 abhi apne contacts mein save kar lijiye.

porn-law-myths-india.en:
Ask a hostel corridor whether watching porn is legal in India and every answer comes back at once: it is banned, it is fine, it is fine unless you forward it, it is fine if you paid. The law is simpler than the rumours. An adult watching adult material in private is on one side. Sending it, anything with a child in it, and anything recorded or shared without consent are on the other. Here are five common claims, tested against statute and the courts. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Myth 1: Watching porn in private is a crime

**The truth:** for an adult, watching adult pornography in private is not an offence in India. In July 2015 the Supreme Court refused an interim order to block pornographic websites. Chief Justice H.L. Dattu observed that the court could not stop an adult from watching pornography in the privacy of their room, citing personal liberty under Article 21 [[hindu-sc-adult-porn-privacy-2015]].

It was an observation made while declining an interim order, not a judgment declaring porn a right. "Adult" has to be true of the viewer and of everyone on screen. "Private" means not pushed on anyone else: the 1997 Vishaka guidelines listed showing pornography among the acts that count as sexual harassment at work [[sc-vishaka-1997]]. And producing, distributing or publishing obscene material remains an offence.

## Myth 2: Forwarding a clip is harmless

**The truth:** the IT Act goes after the person who publishes or transmits, and a forward is a transmission. Sending obscene material online carries up to three years in jail and a fine of up to Rs 5 lakh on a first conviction (Section 67). If the material is sexually explicit, Section 67A raises that to five years and Rs 10 lakh, and to seven years on a repeat conviction [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Police registered 6,990 cases under the Section 67 group in 2024, including 2,914 under Section 67 itself and 2,197 under Section 67A [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Nothing in these sections asks whether you made the clip, were paid, or sent it only to your closest friends.

## Myth 3: Only making child abuse material is a crime, not watching it

**The truth:** where children are concerned, the law reaches the person watching. Section 67B of the IT Act punishes not only publishing such material but creating, collecting, browsing, downloading or exchanging it, with up to five years in jail and a fine of up to Rs 10 lakh on a first conviction [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. A child here is anyone under 18.

On 23 September 2024 the Supreme Court, overturning a Madras High Court ruling, held that viewing, storing or possessing child sexual abuse material is an offence under Section 15 of the POCSO Act and Section 67B [[scobserver-sc-cseam-2024]]. Watching such material online without downloading it can still amount to possession, the court said, if the viewer exercised control over it [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]]. The ruling revived a prosecution; it convicted no one.

So "I only watched" is no defence, and a 17-year-old on screen is a child whatever the video's title claims. If such a file reaches your phone, do not save it or forward it "as a warning". Report it at cybercrime.gov.in.

## Myth 4: If it is on a big site, everyone consented

**The truth:** a site's size tells you about its traffic, not about the people in its videos. No viewer can check an age or an agreement through a screen.

By 30 April 2024, about 1.94 lakh complaints about child sexual abuse material and rape or gang-rape content had been reported on India's National Cybercrime Reporting Portal, the government told the Rajya Sabha [[pib-wcd-ccpwc-2024]]. That is a running total since the portal's 2019 launch, of complaints rather than FIRs, and only of what somebody chose to report. Since 2021 the IT Rules have required large social media platforms to use automated tools to find content depicting rape or child sexual abuse [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Nobody writes that rule for material that is not being uploaded.

Consider a clip labelled a "leaked" video of a couple. If one of them never agreed to the upload, sharing it is an offence. Section 66E of the IT Act covers images of a person's private parts captured or shared without consent [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Section 77 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) treats sharing a woman's private image without her consent as voyeurism even if she agreed to its being taken [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. If either person is under 18, the viewer is back inside Myth 3.

The law may not charge an adult for pressing play, but views are what make uploading worthwhile. The useful question is whether you have any reason to believe these people agreed to be there. A title that sells a leak or a hidden camera has already answered it.

## Myth 5: Adult OTT apps are legal, so anything goes

**The truth:** a subscription page and an app icon are not a licence. In July 2025 the government ordered intermediaries to disable access to 25 streaming platforms, covering 26 websites and 14 apps, for hosting obscene and sexually explicit content [[indiatoday-ott-ban-2025]]. On 22 July 2026 the Information and Broadcasting Ministry told the Lok Sabha that 50 platforms had been blocked in two years, citing Sections 67 and 67A of the IT Act, Section 294 of the BNS and the Indecent Representation of Women Act [[ls-uq680-2026]].

Those are the publishing offences from Myth 2, applied to companies. The orders were directed at platforms, not subscribers. But "it was on a paid app" was never a test of legality, and a scene cut from such an app and passed around a group brings Section 67A back to whoever forwards it.

Adult, private, watching: not an offence. Sending: an offence. Anyone under 18 on screen: an offence to make, send, download, store or watch. Anyone who did not consent: an offence to record or share. To report child abuse material or an intimate image shared without consent, use cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].
porn-law-myths-india.hg:
Kisi hostel corridor mein pooch lo ki India mein porn dekhna legal hai ya nahi, toh saare jawab ek saath milenge: ban hai, theek hai, theek hai jab tak forward na karo, paise dekar dekha toh theek hai. Kanoon in afwaahon se zyada seedha hai. Ek taraf hai kisi adult ka private mein adult material dekhna. Doosri taraf hai use bhejna, aisa kuch bhi jismein koi bachcha ho, aur aisa kuch bhi jo consent ke bina record ya share hua ho. Yahan paanch common daave hain, kanoon aur courts ke saamne rakh kar jaanche gaye. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Myth 1: Private mein porn dekhna crime hai

**Sach:** India mein kisi adult ke liye private mein adult pornography dekhna offence nahi hai. July 2015 mein Supreme Court ne pornographic websites block karne ka interim order dene se mana kar diya. Chief Justice H.L. Dattu ne kaha ki court kisi adult ko apne kamre ki privacy mein pornography dekhne se nahi rok sakta, aur iske liye Article 21 ke tahat personal liberty ka hawala diya [[hindu-sc-adult-porn-privacy-2015]].

Yeh ek observation thi jo interim order se mana karte waqt ki gayi, koi aisa judgment nahi jo porn ko right ghoshit kare. "Adult" dekhne wale ke liye bhi sach hona chahiye aur screen pe dikhne wale har insaan ke liye bhi. "Private" ka matlab hai kisi aur pe thopa na gaya ho: 1997 ki Vishaka guidelines ne pornography dikhana un harkaton mein gina tha jo workplace pe sexual harassment maani jaati hain [[sc-vishaka-1997]]. Aur obscene material banana, distribute karna ya publish karna ab bhi offence hai.

## Myth 2: Clip forward karne mein koi harz nahi

**Sach:** IT Act us insaan ke peeche jaata hai jo publish ya transmit karta hai, aur forward karna transmit karna hi hai. Online obscene material bhejne pe pehli conviction mein teen saal tak ki jail aur 5 lakh rupaye tak ka fine hai (Section 67). Agar material sexually explicit hai, toh Section 67A ise paanch saal aur 10 lakh rupaye tak le jaata hai, aur dobara conviction pe saat saal tak [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Police ne 2024 mein Section 67 group ke tahat 6,990 cases register kiye, jinmein 2,914 khud Section 67 ke aur 2,197 Section 67A ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In sections mein kahin yeh nahi poocha jaata ki clip tumne banayi thi ya nahi, tumhe paise mile ya nahi, ya tumne use sirf apne sabse kareebi doston ko bheja tha ya nahi.

## Myth 3: Child abuse material sirf banana crime hai, dekhna nahi

**Sach:** jahan baat bachchon ki ho, kanoon dekhne wale tak pahunchta hai. IT Act ka Section 67B aisa material sirf publish karne ki nahi, balki use banane, ikattha karne, browse karne, download karne ya exchange karne ki bhi saza deta hai: pehli conviction pe paanch saal tak ki jail aur 10 lakh rupaye tak ka fine [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Yahan bachcha matlab 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi insaan.

23 September 2024 ko Supreme Court ne Madras High Court ka ek faisla palatte hue kaha ki child sexual abuse material dekhna, store karna ya apne paas rakhna POCSO Act ke Section 15 aur Section 67B ke tahat offence hai [[scobserver-sc-cseam-2024]]. Court ne kaha ki aisa material bina download kiye online dekhna bhi possession maana ja sakta hai, agar dekhne wale ka us pe control tha [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]]. Is faisle ne ek prosecution ko dobara zinda kiya; kisi ko convict nahi kiya.

Yaani "maine toh bas dekha tha" koi bachaav nahi hai, aur screen pe 17 saal ka insaan bachcha hi hai, video ka title kuch bhi kahe. Agar aisi file tumhare phone tak pahunche, toh use save mat karo aur "warning ke taur pe" forward bhi mat karo. cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

## Myth 4: Badi site pe hai, toh sabne consent diya hoga

**Sach:** site ka size uske traffic ke baare mein batata hai, uski videos mein dikhne wale logon ke baare mein nahi. Koi viewer screen ke us paar kisi ki umar ya uski marzi check nahi kar sakta.

30 April 2024 tak India ke National Cybercrime Reporting Portal pe child sexual abuse material aur rape ya gang-rape content ke baare mein lagbhag 1.94 lakh complaints aa chuki thi, sarkar ne Rajya Sabha ko bataya [[pib-wcd-ccpwc-2024]]. Yeh 2019 mein portal launch hone ke baad ka kul jod hai, complaints ka hai na ki FIRs ka, aur sirf uska jo kisi ne report karna chuna. 2021 se IT Rules bade social media platforms se maangte hain ki woh automated tools se rape ya child sexual abuse dikhane wala content dhoondhein [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Aisa rule us material ke liye koi nahi likhta jo upload hi na ho raha ho.

Ek clip socho jis pe kisi couple ki "leaked" video ka label laga hai. Agar un dono mein se ek ne upload ke liye kabhi haan nahi kaha, toh use share karna offence hai. IT Act ka Section 66E kisi insaan ke private parts ki un images ko cover karta hai jo consent ke bina kheenchi ya share ki gayi hon [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 77 kisi aurat ki private image uski marzi ke bina share karne ko voyeurism maanta hai, chahe usne image khinchwane ke liye haan kaha ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Aur agar dono mein se koi 18 se kam hai, toh dekhne wala wapas Myth 3 ke andar hai.

Ho sakta hai kanoon kisi adult ko sirf play dabane ke liye charge na kare, par views hi woh cheez hain jinki wajah se upload karna faydemand banta hai. Kaam ka sawaal yeh hai ki tumhare paas yeh maanne ki koi wajah hai ya nahi ki in logon ne yahan hone ke liye haan kaha tha. Jo title leak ya hidden camera bech raha ho, woh iska jawab pehle hi de chuka hai.

## Myth 5: Adult OTT apps legal hain, toh sab chalta hai

**Sach:** subscription page aur app icon koi licence nahi hote. July 2025 mein sarkar ne intermediaries ko 25 streaming platforms ka access band karne ka order diya, jismein 26 websites aur 14 apps aate the, kyunki un pe obscene aur sexually explicit content tha [[indiatoday-ott-ban-2025]]. 22 July 2026 ko Information and Broadcasting Ministry ne Lok Sabha ko bataya ki do saal mein 50 platforms block ho chuke hain, aur isne IT Act ke Sections 67 aur 67A, BNS ke Section 294 aur Indecent Representation of Women Act ka hawala diya [[ls-uq680-2026]].

Yeh wahi publishing wale offences hain jo Myth 2 mein the, bas companies pe lagu kiye gaye. Orders platforms ke khilaaf the, subscribers ke khilaaf nahi. Par "yeh toh paid app pe tha" kabhi legal hone ka test tha hi nahi, aur aisi app se kaata gaya scene jab kisi group mein ghoomta hai, toh Section 67A wapas usi pe aa jaata hai jo use forward karta hai.

Adult, private, dekhna: offence nahi. Bhejna: offence. Screen pe 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi: banana, bhejna, download karna, store karna ya dekhna, sab offence. Jisne consent nahi diya: use record ya share karna offence. Child abuse material ya bina consent ke share hui intimate image report karni ho, toh cybercrime.gov.in use karo ya 1930 pe call karo [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

received-abuse-video-in-group-chat.en:
Consider this: it is late at night and a short video drops into your hostel group, or your family group, captioned "Shameful. Share till she gets justice." It appears to show a woman being sexually assaulted. Within minutes three people have forwarded it to other groups, each sure they are helping. This guide is for the person who stops. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Why 'just forwarding' is not neutral

A video of an assault records a crime and the worst moment of someone's life. Each forward puts it on new phones, where it can be saved, re-uploaded and watched again, and where someone who knows her may recognise her face, her voice or the room. A caption cannot change what a forward does: it shows her, without her consent, to more people.

Police do not need everyone in the group to see the video. They need to know where it is. India built a reporting route for exactly this. The National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, cybercrime.gov.in, began as a pilot on 30 August 2019 with a specific focus on crimes against women and children, including child sexual abuse material and rape or gang-rape videos [[pib-mha-i4c-launch-2020]]. By 30 April 2024 it had received about 1.94 lakh complaints about such content [[pib-wcd-ccpwc-2024]]. Those are complaints, not police cases.

## The laws a single forward can break

**Sexually explicit material.** Section 67A of the IT Act punishes publishing or transmitting sexually explicit material: up to 5 years in jail and a fine of up to Rs 10 lakh on a first conviction, up to seven years on a repeat [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Police registered 2,197 cases under it in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**A child in the video.** If the person shown is under 18, Section 67B applies, covering browsing, downloading and exchanging such material, with the same penalties [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. In 2024 the Supreme Court held that even viewing or storing it can be an offence [[scobserver-sc-cseam-2024]].

**The survivor's identity.** Section 72 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) makes it a crime to publish a rape survivor's name or anything that could reveal who she is, punishable with up to two years in jail and a fine, unless she authorises it in writing [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. In Nipun Saxena v. Union of India (2018), the Supreme Court ruled that no one may name a survivor in print, electronic or social media, or "even in a remote manner" disclose facts that could identify her [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. A video showing her face does exactly that; so does a caption naming her college or village. For a child of any gender, POCSO separately bars any media report from revealing the child's identity [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Police registered just 11 cases under Section 72 across India in July-December 2024, the first six months of the BNS [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A number that small reflects how rarely the law is used, not how rarely it is broken.

## Report, do not repost: the portal's women-and-children route

On cybercrime.gov.in, choose the section for crimes against women and children. It takes complaints about child sexual abuse material and rape or gang-rape content [[cybercrime-portal]]. Or call 1930, the national cyber crime helpline [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Write down what investigators need: the group's name, the number or username that posted the video, the date and time, and any link. Describe where you saw it rather than attaching the video; if it shows a child, never attach it.

Then report the message and the sender inside the app. Large platforms must deploy technical measures to identify content depicting rape or child sexual abuse [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]], and a user report points them to the copy in front of you. If anyone in the video may still be in danger, call 112. If a child is involved, also call 1098, the 24x7 Child Helpline [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

## What to tell the group, and the admin

Say it once, without quoting or reposting anything: "This video shows a crime. Sharing it is also a crime, and it can identify the survivor. Please delete it and don't forward it. I have reported it." Don't speculate about who she is, whether it is "real" or why she was there. Each such message spreads her identity, or the blame, a little further.

Then message the admin privately. Ask them to delete the message for everyone, remove the sender and limit who can post, using whichever of these controls the app gives admins.

Once you have reported it, delete the video from the chat and from your phone's gallery or downloads, and switch off automatic media downloads for that group. If it shows a child, this matters in law: as the Supreme Court read Section 15 of POCSO, storing such material without deleting, destroying or reporting it is an offence [[scobserver-sc-cseam-2024]]. Keep your note of where you saw it, not the file.

## If you know the person in the video

Do not confirm who she is to anyone, in the group or outside it, and do not tag, name or hint. She may not know the video exists. Tell her privately, in person or on a call, never by sending it, and let her decide what happens next. If she wants it blocked on public platforms, StopNCII.org works for images taken at 18 or older [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]] and NCMEC's Take It Down for those taken under 18 [[ncmec-take-it-down]]; both work only on partner platforms, not inside private encrypted chats.

If she is under 18, tell an adult who can protect her. Under POCSO, anyone who knows of child sexual abuse must report it to the police [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Survivors in these videos are not only women and girls. Boys and men are filmed too, and the same rules hold: don't forward, don't identify, report. And seeing such a video can stay with you. If it does, talk to someone; Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
received-abuse-video-in-group-chat.hg:
Socho: raat ka time hai aur tumhare hostel group, ya family group, mein ek chhota sa video aata hai, is caption ke saath: "Sharmnaak. Itna share karo ki use insaaf mile." Video mein lagta hai ki ek woman ka sexual assault ho raha hai. Kuch hi minutes mein teen log use doosre groups mein forward kar dete hain, aur teeno ko lagta hai ki woh help kar rahe hain. Yeh guide us insaan ke liye hai jo ruk jaata hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## 'Bas forward kiya' neutral kyun nahi hai

Assault ka video ek crime ka record hai, aur kisi ki zindagi ke sabse bure pal ka bhi. Har forward use naye phones tak pahunchata hai, jahan use save kiya ja sakta hai, dobara upload kiya ja sakta hai, baar-baar dekha ja sakta hai, aur jahan koi jaan-pehchaan wala uska chehra, uski awaaz ya woh kamra pehchaan sakta hai. Caption badalne se forward ka asar nahi badalta: woh use, uske consent ke bina, aur logon ko dikha deta hai.

Police ko yeh zaroorat nahi ki group ka har insaan video dekhe. Unhe bas yeh jaanna hai ki video kahan hai. India ne theek isi kaam ke liye reporting ka rasta banaya hai. National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, cybercrime.gov.in, 30 August 2019 ko pilot ke roop mein shuru hua, aur uska khaas focus women aur children ke against crimes pe tha, jisme child sexual abuse material aur rape ya gang-rape videos shaamil hain [[pib-mha-i4c-launch-2020]]. 30 April 2024 tak is portal pe aise content ke baare mein lagbhag 1.94 lakh complaints aa chuki thin [[pib-wcd-ccpwc-2024]]. Yeh complaints hain, police cases nahi.

## Ek forward kaun-kaun se law tod sakta hai

**Sexually explicit material.** IT Act ka Section 67A sexually explicit material publish ya transmit karne pe saza deta hai: first conviction pe 5 saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10 lakh tak ka fine, dobara conviction pe saat saal tak [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. 2024 mein police ne is section ke under 2,197 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**Video mein koi bachcha.** Agar video mein dikhne wala insaan 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh Section 67B lagta hai, jo aisa material browse, download aur exchange karne ko bhi cover karta hai, aur saza wahi hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. 2024 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki use dekhna ya store karna bhi offence ho sakta hai [[scobserver-sc-cseam-2024]].

**Survivor ki pehchaan.** Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 72 rape survivor ka naam, ya koi bhi aisi baat jisse pata chale ki woh kaun hai, publish karne ko crime banata hai. Iski saza do saal tak ki jail aur fine hai, jab tak survivor khud likhkar ijaazat na de [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Nipun Saxena v. Union of India (2018) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki koi bhi print, electronic ya social media mein survivor ka naam nahi le sakta, aur "even in a remote manner", yaani door ke ishaare se bhi, aisi baatein nahi bata sakta jinse uski pehchaan ho jaaye [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. Jis video mein uska chehra dikhta hai, woh theek yahi karta hai; woh caption bhi, jisme uske college ya gaon ka naam ho. Kisi bhi gender ke bachche ke liye, POCSO alag se kisi bhi media report ko bachche ki pehchaan zaahir karne se rokta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

July-December 2024 mein, yaani BNS ke pehle chhe mahinon mein, poore India mein police ne Section 72 ke under sirf 11 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Itna chhota number yeh dikhata hai ki law kitna kam use hota hai, yeh nahi ki use kitni kam baar toda jaata hai.

## Report karo, repost nahi: portal ka women-and-children wala rasta

cybercrime.gov.in pe women aur children ke against crimes wala section choose karo. Yeh child sexual abuse material aur rape ya gang-rape content ki complaints leta hai [[cybercrime-portal]]. Ya phir 1930 pe call karo, jo national cyber crime helpline hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Investigators ko jo chahiye, woh likh lo: group ka naam, jis number ya username ne video daala, date aur time, aur koi link ho toh woh. Video attach karne ki jagah batao ki tumne use kahan dekha; agar usme koi bachcha hai, toh use kabhi attach mat karo.

Phir app ke andar message aur bhejne wale, dono ko report karo. Bade platforms ko rape ya child sexual abuse dikhane wala content pehchaanne ke liye technical measures lagane hote hain [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]], aur user ki report unhe tumhare saamne wali copy tak le jaati hai. Agar video mein koi abhi bhi khatre mein ho sakta hai, toh 112 pe call karo. Agar koi bachcha involved hai, toh 1098 pe bhi call karo, jo 24x7 Child Helpline hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

## Group ko kya kahein, aur admin ko

Ek baar bolo, kuch quote ya repost kiye bina: "Is video mein ek crime dikh raha hai. Ise share karna bhi crime hai, aur isse survivor ki pehchaan ho sakti hai. Please ise delete karo aur forward mat karo. Maine ise report kar diya hai." Yeh andaaza mat lagao ki woh kaun hai, video "asli" hai ya nahi, ya woh wahan kyun thi. Aisa har message uski pehchaan, ya blame, thoda aur aage failata hai.

Phir admin ko alag se message karo. Unse kaho ki message sabke liye delete karein, bhejne wale ko group se nikaalein aur yeh limit karein ki kaun post kar sakta hai, app admins ko jo bhi controls deta ho unke zariye.

Report karne ke baad video ko chat se aur apne phone ki gallery ya downloads se delete karo, aur us group ke liye automatic media download band kar do. Agar usme koi bachcha hai, toh law ke hisaab se bhi yeh zaroori hai: Supreme Court ne POCSO ke Section 15 ko jis tarah padha, uske mutabik aisa material bina delete, destroy ya report kiye store karna offence hai [[scobserver-sc-cseam-2024]]. Apne paas yeh note rakho ki video kahan dekha, file nahi.

## Agar tum video wale insaan ko jaante ho

Kisi ko bhi, group mein ya bahar, confirm mat karo ki woh kaun hai, aur na tag karo, na naam lo, na ishaara karo. Ho sakta hai use pata hi na ho ki video maujood hai. Use akele mein batao, saamne ya call pe, video bhejkar kabhi nahi, aur aage kya karna hai, yeh use decide karne do. Agar woh chahe ki public platforms pe video block ho, toh StopNCII.org 18 ya usse zyada umar mein li gayi images ke liye kaam karta hai [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]] aur NCMEC ka Take It Down 18 se kam umar mein li gayi images ke liye [[ncmec-take-it-down]]; dono sirf partner platforms pe kaam karte hain, private encrypted chats ke andar nahi.

Agar woh 18 se kam umar ki hai, toh kisi aise adult ko batao jo uski hifaazat kar sake. POCSO ke under, jise bhi child sexual abuse ka pata ho, use police ko report karna zaroori hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Aise videos mein survivors sirf women aur ladkiyan nahi hoti. Ladkon aur mardon ke bhi video banaye jaate hain, aur rules wahi hain: forward mat karo, pehchaan mat batao, report karo. Aur aisa video dekhna dimaag mein reh sakta hai. Agar aisa ho, toh kisi se baat karo; Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur din-raat chalta hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

sextortion-myths-paying-deleting-shame.en:
The script rarely changes. A friendly profile, often posing as a young woman, moves the chat to a video call or asks for a photo. Then the tone flips: a recording, a threat to send it to your family and friends, an amount and a deadline. WeProtect Global Alliance, which tracks this crime worldwide, says the move from first message to coercion can take minutes to hours [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. What keeps the racket profitable is not clever technology. It is five beliefs that make people pay and stay silent. Here is each one, checked against the evidence.

## Myth 1: Pay once and it is over

**The truth:** a payment tells the blackmailer two things: that you can pay, and that you are frightened enough to pay again. It buys nothing you can check. There is no receipt for a deletion.

WeProtect cites research finding that 70% of victims who ignore demands for payment do not have their images distributed afterwards [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. That figure comes from a global study, not from Indian data, and it is not a guarantee. But it points one way. The threat is the product being sold, and refusing to buy often ends the sale.

What protects you is not money but a sequence: stop replying, save the chat, the profile link, the payment demand and any phone number, then block and report.

## Myth 2: Only girls get targeted

**The truth:** in sextortion for money, boys are the main target. WeProtect's 2024 briefing says the main targets are teenage boys aged 13 to 17, usually tricked into believing they are talking to a young woman [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. When the Canadian Centre for Child Protection analysed more than 6,500 first-hand accounts that sextortion victims had posted publicly, 98% were male where gender could be identified [[weprotect-gta-2023]]. Those were self-selected posts, not a survey, but the direction is clear.

This matters in India, where boys are rarely told they can be victims at all, and a boy who has never heard it may tell no one. If the person targeted is under 18, the POCSO Act protects them whatever their gender [[pocso-act-2012]]. Anyone under 18 can call the Child Helpline 1098, which runs 24x7 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

## Myth 3: It is your fault for being on the call

**The truth:** being deceived is not a crime. Recording or spreading someone's intimate image without consent is. Under the IT Act, capturing or sharing images of a person's private parts without consent (Section 66E) carries up to three years in jail, and publishing sexually explicit material (Section 67A) carries up to five years and a fine of up to Rs 10 lakh on a first conviction [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

For women, Section 77 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) adds that agreeing to an image being taken is not agreeing to its sharing [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. That section protects only women; for everyone else, the IT Act sections apply. And when the target is a child, Section 67B separately punishes enticing children into online sexual relationships [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

Shame is the blackmailer's real weapon. NCMEC, the US child-protection clearinghouse, says it knows of at least 36 teenage boys in the United States who have taken their own lives since 2021 after being victimised by sextortion [[ncmec-2024-in-numbers-2025]]. Whatever is in the recording, you can get through it, and you do not have to do it alone. If the fear feels unbearable, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, the Health Ministry's free helpline that answers round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. The shame belongs to the person holding the recording, not to you.

## Myth 4: The police will do nothing anyway

**The truth:** this one is partly right, and pretending otherwise helps nobody. In 2024 Indian police registered 601 cases of cyber blackmailing or threatening. Of 1,221 such cases before the courts that year, only two ended in conviction, and 98% were still pending at year end [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A senior Maharashtra Cyber police officer estimated in 2022 that fewer than 0.5% of sextortion cases in India are registered as FIRs. That is an estimate, not a measured rate, but it fits the silence [[toi-yadav-sextortion-oped-2022]]. Our investigation into India's video-call sextortion racket looks at why so few cases reach that stage.

Still, a conviction is not the only thing a report gets you. The national helpline 1930 and the portal cybercrime.gov.in, run by the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), exist to help you file an online complaint, with a special focus on crimes against women and children [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. A report puts the account, the number and the payment trail on record. And getting an image removed does not have to wait for the police at all.

## Myth 5: It will be on every phone in minutes

**The truth:** India's rules now give you a fast way to get the image taken down. Since 20 February 2026, platforms must remove nude, sexual or morphed images of a person within two hours of that person's complaint, down from 24 hours [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. The complaint can come from you or someone acting on your behalf, and it needs no FIR or court order [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]].

Hash tools can also stop re-uploads without you sending the image to anyone. StopNCII, for images taken at 18 or older, was protecting 2 million images by November 2025 [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]]. Take It Down, for images taken under 18, is anonymous and works in Hindi [[ncmec-take-it-down]]. Both work only on platforms that have signed up, so they are a shield, not a guarantee. Our step-by-step guide to the first hour after a leak shows how to use each one.

None of this makes the fear disappear overnight. It does mean the blackmailer's two loudest claims, that paying ends it and that nothing can stop the spread, do not hold up.
sextortion-myths-paying-deleting-shame.hg:
Script almost har baar same hota hai. Ek friendly profile, jo aksar kisi young ladki ki hone ka natak karti hai, chat ko video call pe le jaati hai ya photo maangti hai. Phir tone ekdum badal jaata hai: ek recording, dhamki ki yeh tumhari family aur dosto ko bhej denge, ek amount aur ek deadline. WeProtect Global Alliance, jo duniya bhar mein is crime ko track karta hai, kehta hai ki pehle message se dhamki tak pahunchne mein kuch minute se kuch ghante lagte hain [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Yeh racket kisi clever technology ke dum pe nahi chalta. Yeh paanch galat beliefs pe chalta hai jo logon ko pay karne aur chup rehne pe majboor karte hain. Chalo, har ek ko evidence ke saath check karte hain.

## Myth 1: Ek baar pay karo aur baat khatam

**Sach:** Payment karke tum blackmailer ko do cheezein bata dete ho: ki tum pay kar sakte ho, aur ki tum itne dare hue ho ki dobara bhi karoge. Badle mein tumhe kuch aisa nahi milta jise tum check kar sako. Delete karne ki koi receipt nahi hoti.

WeProtect ek research cite karta hai jiske hisaab se jo victims payment ki demand ignore karte hain, unme se 70% ki images baad mein distribute nahi hoti [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Yeh figure ek global study se hai, Indian data se nahi, aur yeh guarantee bhi nahi hai. Lekin ishara ek hi taraf hai. Blackmailer asal mein dhamki bech raha hai, aur khareedne se mana karo toh aksar sauda wahin khatam ho jaata hai.

Tumhe paisa nahi bachata, sahi steps sahi order mein bachate hain: reply band karo, chat, profile link, paise ki demand aur koi bhi phone number save karo, phir block aur report karo.

## Myth 2: Sirf ladkiyan target hoti hain

**Sach:** Paise ke liye hone wale sextortion mein main target ladke hain. WeProtect ki 2024 briefing kehti hai ki iske main targets 13 se 17 saal ke teenage ladke hain, jinhe aksar yakeen dilaya jaata hai ki woh kisi young ladki se baat kar rahe hain [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Jab Canadian Centre for Child Protection ne 6,500 se zyada aise first-hand accounts analyse kiye jo sextortion victims ne publicly post kiye the, toh jahan gender pata chal saka, wahan 98% male the [[weprotect-gta-2023]]. Yeh logon ki apni marzi se likhi posts thi, koi survey nahi, lekin direction saaf hai.

India mein yeh baat bahut matter karti hai, kyunki yahan ladkon ko shayad hi kabhi bataya jaata hai ki woh bhi victim ho sakte hain, aur jisne yeh kabhi suna hi nahi, woh shayad kisi ko na bataye. Agar target 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh POCSO Act use protect karta hai, chahe uska gender kuch bhi ho [[pocso-act-2012]]. 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi bachcha Child Helpline 1098 pe call kar sakta hai, jo 24x7 chalti hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

## Myth 3: Call pe tum the, toh galti tumhari hai

**Sach:** Dhokha kha jaana crime nahi hai. Bina consent kisi ki intimate image record karna ya phailana crime hai. IT Act ke under, bina consent kisi ke private parts ki images capture ya share karne (Section 66E) pe teen saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai. Sexually explicit material publish karne (Section 67A) pe pehli conviction mein hi paanch saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10 lakh tak ka fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Women ke liye Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 77 ek baat aur clear karta hai: photo lene ke liye haan kehna, use aage share karne ki haan nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yeh section sirf women ko protect karta hai; baaki sabke liye IT Act ke sections laagu hote hain. Aur jab target koi bachcha ho, toh Section 67B alag se bachchon ko online sexual relationship mein phasane ko punish karta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

Sharam hi blackmailer ka asli hathiyar hai. NCMEC, jo US ka child-protection clearinghouse hai, kehta hai ki 2021 se use US ke kam se kam 36 teenage ladkon ke baare mein pata hai jinhone sextortion ka shikaar hone ke baad apni jaan le li [[ncmec-2024-in-numbers-2025]]. Recording mein jo bhi ho, tum isse nikal sakte ho, aur tumhe yeh akele nahi jhelna hai. Agar darr bardasht se bahar lage, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo. Yeh Health Ministry ki free helpline hai jo 24 ghante chalti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Sharam uski hai jiske paas recording hai, tumhari nahi.

## Myth 4: Police kuch karegi hi nahi

**Sach:** Isme thodi sachchai hai, aur ise chhupane se kisi ka bhala nahi hoga. 2024 mein Indian police ne cyber blackmailing ya threatening ke 601 cases register kiye. Us saal courts ke saamne aise 1,221 cases the. Unme se sirf do mein conviction hua, aur saal ke end tak 98% pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Maharashtra Cyber ke ek senior police officer ne 2022 mein estimate kiya tha ki India mein sextortion ke 0.5% se bhi kam cases mein FIR register hoti hai. Yeh ek estimate hai, measured rate nahi, lekin yeh is chuppi se match karta hai [[toi-yadav-sextortion-oped-2022]]. India ke video-call sextortion racket pe hamari investigation batati hai ki itne kam cases FIR tak kyun pahunchte hain.

Phir bhi, report karne ka fayda sirf conviction nahi hai. National helpline 1930 aur portal cybercrime.gov.in, jo Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) chalata hai, online complaint file karne mein help ke liye bane hain, aur women aur children ke khilaf cyber crimes pe inka special focus hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. Report karne se account, number aur payment trail record pe aa jaate hain. Aur image hatwane ke liye toh police ka wait karne ki zarurat hi nahi hai.

## Myth 5: Minuton mein har phone tak pahunch jaayega

**Sach:** India ke rules ab image jaldi hatwane ka ek tez raasta dete hain. 20 February 2026 se platforms ko kisi ki nude, sexual ya morphed images us insaan ki complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar hatani hoti hain. Pehle yeh time 24 ghante tha [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Complaint tum khud kar sakte ho ya tumhari taraf se koi aur, aur iske liye na FIR chahiye, na court order [[meity-it-rules-2021-consolidated-2025]].

Hash tools bhi re-uploads rok sakte hain, aur iske liye tumhe image kisi ko bhejni nahi padti. StopNCII, jo 18 ya usse zyada umar mein li gayi images ke liye hai, November 2025 tak 2 million (20 lakh) images ko protect kar raha tha [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]]. Take It Down, jo 18 se kam umar mein li gayi images ke liye hai, anonymous hai aur Hindi mein bhi kaam karta hai [[ncmec-take-it-down]]. Dono sirf unhi platforms pe kaam karte hain jo inke saath jude hain, isliye yeh ek shield hain, guarantee nahi. Leak ke baad ke pehle ghante pe hamari step-by-step guide batati hai ki inhe kaise use karna hai.

Isse darr raaton-raat khatam nahi hoga. Lekin itna clear hai ki blackmailer ke do sabse bade claims, ki pay karne se baat khatam ho jaati hai aur ki image ko phailne se koi nahi rok sakta, dono mein dum nahi hai.

sextortion-targets-teenage-boys.en:
Picture the person most likely to be sextorted for money. If you pictured a young woman, the evidence says otherwise. Financial sextortion mainly targets teenage boys aged 13 to 17, who are usually tricked into believing they are chatting with a young woman [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. The US-based National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) says teenage boys have been the most common targets in recent sextortion cases [[ncmec-sextortion-issue-page]]. In India, nobody can tell you how many boys this has happened to, because police data have no sextortion category at all [[toi-yadav-sextortion-oped-2022]]. The boys are there. The column is not.

## Why boys: a script built on a fake girlfriend

The scam is written for a teenage boy's world. A profile posing as a young woman starts the chat, and things move fast: the step from first message to coercion can take minutes to hours [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. That speed is the point: it leaves no time to think, ask or check.

Consider this situation. A 15-year-old in Bhopal has just sent a photo to the "girl" he has been chatting with for an hour. The photo comes back with screenshots of his followers, his school's name and a demand for money. In his head, every exit looks worse than paying. Tell his parents? They will see the photo. Tell a friend? The whole school will know. Tell the police? Boys are not supposed to be victims.

None of this is about stupidity. Many boys grow up hearing that they must handle their problems alone, and rarely hear that a boy can be a victim. The blackmailer does not need a boy to be naive, only alone.

## 98%: what victim accounts reveal

The Canadian Centre for Child Protection (C3P) analysed more than 6,500 first-hand accounts posted publicly by people who had been sexually extorted. Where the victim's gender could be identified, 98% were male [[weprotect-gta-2023]]. These were self-selected posts, not a representative survey, and the writers include young men as well as boys.

Reporting centres see the scale growing. NCMEC says online enticement reports rose by more than 300% between 2021 and 2023 [[ncmec-sextortion-issue-page]]. In 2025 it received more than 80,000 reports concerning sextortion, part of 1.4 million online enticement reports, up 158% on 2024, a jump that partly reflects a 2024 US law obliging platforms to report enticement [[ncmec-cybertipline-data-2025]].

Indian teenagers are inside this picture. In a 2023 Snap survey of more than 6,000 teens and young adults in six countries including India, 65% said they or their friends had been targeted by sextortion schemes through catfishing or hacking [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. The figure pools six countries and counts friends' experiences, so it overstates personal risk. It still says this is not rare.

## The silence that turns a scam into a crisis

Because Indian police data have no sextortion category, no official number shows how many Indian boys are targeted, how many paid, or how many told anyone. In 2024 police recorded 1,753 cyber crimes against children, 1,099 of them involving sexually explicit material depicting children [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Sextortion is not a line in that table.

Young men fall through another gap. NCRB publishes separate cyber crime counts for women, 18,615 in 2024, and for children [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A 19-year-old man blackmailed over a video call belongs to neither. Offline, the record is thin too: boys were 892 of the 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024, a share that reflects how rarely boys' abuse is reported, not how rarely it happens, as our look at boys in POCSO data explains [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Silence has a cost. NCMEC says that since 2021 it has known of at least 36 teenage boys in the United States who took their own lives after being victimised by sextortion [[ncmec-2024-in-numbers-2025]]. The threat is engineered to make a boy believe his life is over. It is not. In research cited by WeProtect, 70% of victims who ignored payment demands did not have their images shared [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. If you are reading this with a threat on your screen and thoughts of ending your life, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, the Health Ministry's free helpline that answers round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

## What a boy should do, and what parents must not say

If you are a boy facing this, three things are true. You are not stupid: you were targeted by people who do this as a business. The blackmail is the crime: if you are under 18, POCSO protects boys exactly as it protects girls [[pocso-act-2012]], and enticing a child into an online sexual relationship is itself an offence under Section 67B of the IT Act [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. And you do not have to face it alone: tell one adult tonight, a parent, an older cousin or a teacher. Our step-by-step sextortion guide covers the rest.

Parents, brothers and uncles: the words that feel natural can do the most damage. Do not say "be a man" or "why are you crying". Do not call him stupid, do not joke about it, do not make it about the family's izzat, and do not threaten to tell relatives. Each of those lines teaches a boy to handle it alone next time, which is exactly what the blackmailer wants. Tell him the person blackmailing him is the criminal, and that you will deal with it together.

## Where to get help tonight

- Cyber crime helpline: 1930, or file at cybercrime.gov.in [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].
- Images taken before 18: NCMEC's Take It Down is free, anonymous and available in Hindi. It sends only a digital fingerprint of the image to participating platforms, never the image itself [[ncmec-take-it-down]].
- Under 18 and need an adult on your side: Child Helpline 1098 runs round the clock and is linked to the emergency number 112 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- Feeling that you cannot cope: Tele-MANAS, 14416, free and round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

The deadline on your screen is a pressure tactic. The shame belongs to the person who sent it. Make one call tonight.
sextortion-targets-teenage-boys.hg:
Socho, paison ke liye sabse zyada sextort kise kiya jaata hai. Agar tumhare dimaag mein kisi young ladki ki image aayi, toh evidence kuch aur kehta hai. Financial sextortion ka main target 13 se 17 saal ke teenage ladke hain, jinhe aksar yakeen dilaya jaata hai ki woh kisi young ladki se chat kar rahe hain [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. US ki National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) kehti hai ki recent sextortion cases mein sabse common target teenage ladke rahe hain [[ncmec-sextortion-issue-page]]. India mein koi nahi bata sakta ki kitne ladkon ke saath aisa hua, kyunki police data mein sextortion ki koi category hi nahi hai [[toi-yadav-sextortion-oped-2022]]. Ladke wahan hain. Unka column nahi.

## Ladke hi kyun: fake girlfriend pe bana script

Yeh scam ek teenage ladke ki duniya ke hisaab se likha gaya hai. Ek profile, jo young ladki hone ka natak karti hai, chat shuru karti hai, aur sab kuch tezi se hota hai: pehle message se dhamki tak pahunchne mein kuch minute se le ke kuch ghante lagte hain [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Yahi speed asli chaal hai: sochne, poochhne ya check karne ka time hi nahi milta.

Ek situation socho. Bhopal ka ek 15 saal ka ladka us "ladki" ko apni ek photo bhej deta hai, jisse woh ghante bhar se chat kar raha tha. Photo wapas aati hai, saath mein uske followers ke screenshots, uske school ka naam aur paison ki demand. Uske dimaag mein har raasta pay karne se bura lagta hai. Parents ko bataye? Woh photo dekh lenge. Dost ko bataye? Poore school ko pata chal jayega. Police ko bataye? Ladke toh victim hote hi nahi.

Ismein bewakoofi wali koi baat nahi hai. Bahut se ladke yeh sunte hue bade hote hain ki apni problem khud sambhalo, aur unhe shayad hi kabhi bataya jaata hai ki ladke ke saath bhi crime ho sakta hai. Blackmailer ko bhola ladka nahi chahiye, bas akela ladka chahiye.

## 98%: victims ke accounts kya batate hain

Canadian Centre for Child Protection (C3P) ne 6,500 se zyada first-hand accounts padhe, jo sextortion jhel chuke logon ne khud online post kiye the. Jahan gender pata chal saka, unmein se 98% male the [[weprotect-gta-2023]]. Yeh logon ki apni marzi se likhi posts thi, koi representative survey nahi, aur likhne walon mein ladkon ke saath young men bhi the.

Reporting centres ke paas bhi yeh problem badhti dikh rahi hai. NCMEC ke mutabik online enticement, yaani bachchon ko online phusla ke fasane ki reports, 2021 se 2023 ke beech 300% se zyada badh gayi [[ncmec-sextortion-issue-page]]. 2025 mein use sextortion se judi 80,000 se zyada reports mili. Yeh 1.4 million online enticement reports ka hissa thi, jo 2024 se 158% zyada thi. Is uchhaal ki ek wajah 2024 ka ek US kanoon bhi hai, jo platforms ko enticement report karne pe majboor karta hai [[ncmec-cybertipline-data-2025]].

Indian teenagers is picture ke andar hain. 2023 mein Snap ke ek survey mein India samet chhe deshon ke 6,000 se zyada teens aur young adults mein se 65% ne kaha ki unhe ya unke doston ko catfishing ya hacking ke zariye sextortion schemes mein target kiya gaya [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]]. Yeh figure chhe deshon ko mila ke hai aur doston ke experience bhi ginta hai, isliye personal risk ko badha-chadha ke dikhata hai. Phir bhi yeh saaf hai ki yeh rare nahi hai.

## Woh chuppi jo scam ko crisis bana deti hai

Indian police data mein sextortion ki category nahi hai, isliye koi official number nahi batata ki kitne Indian ladke target hue, kitno ne pay kiya, ya kitno ne kisi ko bataya. 2024 mein police ne bachchon ke khilaaf 1,753 cyber crimes record kiye, jinmein se 1,099 bachchon ko dikhane wale sexually explicit material se jude the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us table mein sextortion ki koi line nahi hai.

Young men ek aur gap se gir jaate hain. NCRB mahilaon ke khilaaf cyber crimes alag ginta hai, 2024 mein 18,615, aur bachchon ke khilaaf bhi alag [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Video call pe blackmail hua 19 saal ka ladka in dono mein se kisi mein nahi aata. Offline bhi record patla hi hai: 2024 mein POCSO ke under penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims record hue, jinmein sirf 892 ladke the. Jaisa POCSO data mein ladkon pe humara article samjhata hai, yeh hissa batata hai ki ladkon ke saath hua abuse kitna kam report hota hai, yeh nahi ki woh kitna kam hota hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Chuppi ki keemat hoti hai. NCMEC kehta hai ki 2021 se ab tak woh United States ke kam se kam 36 aise teenage ladkon ke baare mein jaanta hai, jinhone sextortion ka victim banne ke baad apni jaan le li [[ncmec-2024-in-numbers-2025]]. Dhamki isi tarah banayi jaati hai ki ladke ko lage uski zindagi khatam ho gayi. Aisa nahi hai. WeProtect ki batayi ek research mein, jin victims ne paison ki demand ko ignore kiya, unmein se 70% ki images aage share nahi hui [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Agar tum screen pe dhamki dekhte hue yeh padh rahe ho aur mann mein apni jaan lene ke khayal aa rahe hain, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo. Yeh Health Ministry ki free helpline hai jo din-raat chalti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

## Ladka kya kare, aur parents kya kabhi na kahein

Agar tum woh ladka ho jiske saath yeh ho raha hai, toh teen baatein sach hain. Pehli, tum bewakoof nahi ho: tumhe aise logon ne target kiya hai jinka yahi dhandha hai. Doosri, crime blackmail hai: agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh POCSO ladkon ko bhi utna hi protect karta hai jitna ladkiyon ko [[pocso-act-2012]], aur kisi bachche ko phusla ke online sexual relationship mein kheenchna apne aap mein IT Act ki Section 67B ke under offence hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Teesri, tumhe yeh akele nahi jhelna: aaj raat hi ek bade ko batao, parents, bade cousin ya kisi teacher ko. Baaki saare steps humari sextortion step-by-step guide mein hain.

Parents, bhai aur chacha-mama: jo baatein apne aap munh se nikalti hain, wahi sabse zyada chot karti hain. "Mard bano" ya "ro kyun rahe ho" mat kaho. Use bewakoof mat kaho, iska mazaak mat banao, ise family ki izzat ka sawaal mat banao, aur rishtedaaron ko batane ki dhamki mat do. Inmein se har baat ladke ko yahi sikhati hai ki agli baar sab akele sambhale, aur blackmailer theek yahi chahta hai. Use batao ki criminal woh hai jo use blackmail kar raha hai, aur tum milke isse niptoge.

## Aaj raat help kahan milegi

- Cyber crime helpline: 1930, ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].
- 18 se pehle ki images: NCMEC ka Take It Down free hai, anonymous hai aur Hindi mein bhi hai. Yeh image nahi bhejta, sirf uska digital fingerprint bhejta hai, aur woh bhi sirf un platforms ko jo isse jude hain [[ncmec-take-it-down]].
- 18 se kam umar hai aur koi bada saath chahiye: Child Helpline 1098 din-raat chalti hai aur emergency number 112 se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- Lage ki ab sambhala nahi ja raha: Tele-MANAS, 14416, free aur din-raat [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Screen pe dikh rahi deadline bas darr badhane ki chaal hai. Sharm uski hai jisne woh message bheja. Aaj raat ek call karo.

stalkerware-partner-phone-monitoring-law.en:
Consider this situation. A 26-year-old in Indore notices that her husband knows what she said on a call he did not hear, which friend she met for lunch, and when she left the office. When she asks how, he says he just worries about her. She has told no one, unsure anyone would believe her.

She would be in the majority. In NFHS-5, 77.2% of women aged 18-49 who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Among women abused only by their current husband, just 11.3% ever sought help [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. A watched phone makes telling harder still, because the device you would use to ask for help is the one being read. This explainer is general information, not legal advice.

## Control that looks like care

It rarely starts with an app. It starts with "show me your chats", a demand for passwords, location sharing "for your safety", an angry question about a message you never mentioned. Each step comes with a loving explanation. Together they leave one result: no private space to think, keep friends or ask for help.

Many couples share phones by choice. The test is whether you can say no, change a password or switch off sharing without fearing what happens next. If you cannot, it is control, whether he is a husband, a live-in partner or a boyfriend.

## How stalkerware gets onto a phone

Monitoring apps, often sold as parental controls or "phone trackers", copy messages, photos and location to someone else's account. Many need someone to handle the unlocked phone, if only briefly: easy for someone who knows your PIN.

In August 2026, the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) warned that fake pornography apps advertised on Facebook and Instagram, under names such as "Night Play", "Reloop" and "Kyss", were being used to take over Android phones and commit financial fraud [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. That warning was about fraud, not partners, but the lesson carries over: an app given wide permissions can take over a phone. With a monitoring app, the person who taps "allow" is often not the phone's owner.

Many trackers need no app, only a known password: a shared Google or iCloud account, WhatsApp opened on another computer, location sharing left on, or photos backing up to his cloud account.

## Signs your phone is being watched

No single sign proves anything; look for patterns.

- He knows things you said only in messages or calls, or where you were without being told.
- Apps you do not recognise, perhaps named like system tools.
- Apps with accessibility, device-admin or notification access that you never granted.
- Permission to "install unknown apps" switched on for a browser or file manager.
- Devices you do not recognise among WhatsApp's linked devices or in your Google or Apple account.

Before removing anything, think about safety. Deleting an app or changing a password tells the watcher you have noticed, and with an abusive partner that moment can be dangerous. Screenshot everything first, as evidence, and make a plan with someone you trust.

## What BNS Section 78 and the Domestic Violence Act can do

Stalking is a crime under Section 78 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, with up to three years in jail on first conviction and up to five on a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 9,865 stalking cases in 2024, and they count the online kind separately: 1,224 cases of cyber stalking or bullying of women that year [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Whether a particular pattern of phone monitoring amounts to stalking depends on the facts, which is why a dated record of what he knew, and when, matters.

If the abuse comes from a husband or happens at home, the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 adds a route that is mainly civil: protection, residence and maintenance orders rather than jail [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Breaching a protection order is an offence, punishable with up to one year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 20,000, or both [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Police registered only 616 criminal cases under the Act in 2024, and 496 were in Kerala [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Since most relief under the Act is civil, that count shows how rarely its criminal side is used, not how rare abuse is.

| Your situation | What can help |
|---|---|
| Watched, tracked or followed, online or offline | A stalking complaint to police (Section 78 BNS), or a cyber stalking report on 1930 |
| Abuse by a husband or at home | Civil orders under the 2005 Act; breaching a protection order is a crime |
| Intimate images captured or shared | Section 66E of the IT Act, for any gender: up to three years, a fine of up to Rs 2 lakh, or both [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. For a woman, Section 77 BNS too: sharing her private image without consent is voyeurism even if she agreed to the picture [[indiacode-bns-2023]] |

The gaps are real. The 2005 Act, as its name says, protects women, and Section 77 BNS covers a woman's images. A man or queer person whose partner plants spyware has fewer named offences to point to, though Section 66E of the IT Act protects any person [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

## Getting help without tipping off the abuser

Use a device he has never touched, such as a friend's phone or a library computer; open a private window, and log out when you finish.

You can also go in person. A woman's complaint of stalking must be recorded by a woman police officer [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. As of July 2026, 985 One Stop Centres were operational across India, offering support under one roof to women facing violence [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. The National Commission for Women takes complaints online [[ncw]], and anyone can report cyber stalking on 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

When you have a plan, secure the phone from a clean device: change passwords, sign out of every session, remove linked devices and switch off location sharing.

Privacy in a relationship is not a secret kept from a partner. It is the space in which a person can still ask for help.
stalkerware-partner-phone-monitoring-law.hg:
Yeh situation socho. Indore ki ek 26 saal ki aurat notice karti hai ki uske husband ko pata hai ki usne us call pe kya kaha jo usne suni hi nahi, lunch pe woh kis dost se mili, aur office se kab nikli. Jab woh poochti hai ki use kaise pata, toh woh kehta hai ki bas use uski fikar hai. Usne kisi ko nahi bataya, kyunki use yakeen nahi ki koi uski baat maanega.

Is maamle mein woh akeli nahi, balki majority mein hai. NFHS-5 mein, 18-49 saal ki jin women ne physical ya sexual violence jhela tha, unmein se 77.2% ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Jin women ke saath sirf unke current husband ne abuse kiya, unmein se sirf 11.3% ne kabhi help maangi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Jab phone pe nazar rakhi ja rahi ho, toh batana aur mushkil ho jaata hai, kyunki jis device se tum help maangoge, wahi padha ja raha hai. Yeh explainer general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Control jo care jaisa dikhta hai

Shuruaat aksar kisi app se nahi hoti. Shuruaat hoti hai "apni chats dikhao" se, passwords ki demand se, "tumhari safety ke liye" location sharing se, kisi aise message pe gusse wale sawaal se jiska tumne zikr hi nahi kiya. Har kadam ke saath ek pyaar bhari explanation aati hai. Sab milkar ek hi nateeja dete hain: sochne, dost rakhne ya help maangne ke liye koi private space nahi bachta.

Kai couples apni marzi se phone share karte hain. Asli test yeh hai ki kya tum bina darr ke mana kar sakte ho, password badal sakte ho ya sharing band kar sakte ho. Agar nahi, toh yeh control hai, chahe saamne husband ho, live-in partner ho ya boyfriend.

## Stalkerware phone tak kaise pahunchta hai

Monitoring apps, jo aksar parental controls ya "phone trackers" ke naam pe bikti hain, messages, photos aur location kisi aur ke account mein copy karti hain. Kai apps ke liye kisi ko khula phone thodi der ke liye haath mein chahiye hota hai: jo tumhara PIN jaanta ho, uske liye yeh aasaan hai.

August 2026 mein Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) ne warning di ki Facebook aur Instagram pe advertise ki gayi fake pornography apps, "Night Play", "Reloop" aur "Kyss" jaise naamon se, Android phones pe kabza karne aur financial fraud ke liye use ho rahi thi [[i4c-advisory-porn-apps-2026]]. Woh warning fraud ke baare mein thi, partners ke baare mein nahi, par sabak wahi hai: jis app ko bahut saari permissions mil jaayein, woh phone pe kabza kar sakti hai. Monitoring app ke case mein "allow" dabane wala aksar phone ka maalik nahi hota.

Kai trackers ko app ki zaroorat hi nahi, bas ek pata hua password chahiye: shared Google ya iCloud account, kisi doosre computer pe khula WhatsApp, on chhoda hua location sharing, ya photos jo uske cloud account mein backup ho rahi hain.

## Signs ki tumhare phone pe nazar rakhi ja rahi hai

Koi ek sign kuch prove nahi karta; pattern dekho.

- Use woh baatein pata hain jo tumne sirf messages ya calls mein kahi, ya bina bataye pata hai ki tum kahan the.
- Aisi apps jinhe tum nahi pehchaante, shayad system tools jaise naam wali.
- Accessibility, device-admin ya notification access wali apps, jinhe tumne yeh access kabhi nahi diya.
- Kisi browser ya file manager ke liye "install unknown apps" permission on hai.
- WhatsApp ke linked devices mein, ya tumhare Google ya Apple account mein, anjaan devices.

Kuch bhi hatane se pehle safety ke baare mein socho. App delete karne ya password badalne se nazar rakhne wale ko pata chal jaata hai ki tumne notice kar liya hai, aur abusive partner ke saath woh pal khatarnak ho sakta hai. Pehle sab ka screenshot lo, evidence ke taur pe, aur kisi bharose wale insaan ke saath plan banao.

## BNS Section 78 aur Domestic Violence Act kya kar sakte hain

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 78 ke under stalking crime hai, jiski saza pehli conviction pe 3 saal tak aur dobara hone pe 5 saal tak hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 2024 mein police ne stalking ke 9,865 cases register kiye, aur online wale cases alag gine: us saal women ke khilaf cyber stalking ya bullying ke 1,224 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Phone pe nazar rakhne ka koi khaas pattern stalking banta hai ya nahi, yeh facts pe depend karta hai, isliye date ke saath record rakhna zaroori hai ki use kya pata tha aur kab.

Agar abuse husband kar raha hai ya ghar ke andar ho raha hai, toh Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ek aur raasta deta hai jo zyada tar civil hai: jail ki jagah protection, residence aur maintenance orders [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Protection order todna offence hai, jis pe 1 saal tak ki jail, Rs 20,000 tak ka fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. 2024 mein police ne is Act ke under sirf 616 criminal cases register kiye, aur unmein se 496 Kerala mein the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kyunki is Act ki zyada tar raahat civil hai, yeh count batata hai ki iska criminal hissa kitna kam use hota hai, yeh nahi ki abuse kitna kam hai.

| Tumhari situation | Kya madad kar sakta hai |
|---|---|
| Online ya offline nazar rakhi jaaye, track kiya jaaye ya peecha kiya jaaye | Police mein stalking ki complaint (Section 78 BNS), ya 1930 pe cyber stalking ki report |
| Husband ka abuse ya ghar ke andar abuse | 2005 Act ke civil orders; protection order todna crime hai |
| Intimate images li gayi ya share ki gayi | IT Act ka Section 66E, kisi bhi gender ke liye: 3 saal tak, Rs 2 lakh tak ka fine, ya dono [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Aurat ke liye Section 77 BNS bhi: uski private image bina consent share karna voyeurism hai, chahe photo khinchwane ke liye usne haan kaha ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]] |

Kamiyaan asli hain. 2005 ka Act, jaisa naam se hi saaf hai, women ko protect karta hai, aur Section 77 BNS aurat ki images ko cover karta hai. Jis aadmi ya queer insaan ke phone mein uska partner spyware daal de, uske paas point karne ke liye kam named offences hain, haalanki IT Act ka Section 66E kisi bhi insaan ko protect karta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

## Abuser ko bina bhanak lage help kaise lo

Aisa device use karo jise usne kabhi haath nahi lagaya, jaise kisi dost ka phone ya library ka computer; private window kholo, aur kaam khatam hone pe log out karo.

Tum khud jaakar bhi help le sakte ho. Kisi aurat ki stalking ki complaint ek woman police officer ko hi record karni hogi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. July 2026 tak poore India mein 985 One Stop Centres chal rahe the, jo violence jhel rahi women ko ek hi chhat ke neeche support dete hain [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. National Commission for Women online complaints leta hai [[ncw]], aur koi bhi 1930 pe ya cybercrime.gov.in pe cyber stalking report kar sakta hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Jab plan ban jaaye, toh kisi clean device se phone secure karo: passwords badlo, har session se sign out karo, linked devices hatao aur location sharing band karo.

Rishte mein privacy partner se chhupaya gaya koi raaz nahi hai. Yeh woh jagah hai jahan se insaan ab bhi help maang sakta hai.

stopncii-take-it-down-hashing-guide.en:
Imagine a 22-year-old in Pune. After a breakup, a photo she once sent her boyfriend appears on a fake account. She reports it; it comes down. Four days later a friend sends her a new link: same photo, new account. Each re-upload restarts the fear and the paperwork.

Hash-matching tools let partner platforms block copies of an intimate photo or video without you sending the image to anyone, and two are free: StopNCII.org for adults and Take It Down for images taken before 18. Since 20 February 2026, platforms in India must also remove nude, sexual or morphed images of a person within two hours of that person's complaint [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Hashing is what can stop the same picture coming straight back.

## What a hash is, and why your photo never leaves your phone

A hash is a digital fingerprint: a short code worked out from the picture itself. The same picture always gives the same code, so a platform holding the code can spot a copy at upload. The code is not the picture: whoever holds it cannot see you.

Both tools make this fingerprint on your own device and send only the code. Take It Down says you can stay anonymous and do not have to send your images or videos to anyone [[ncmec-take-it-down]]; StopNCII makes the hash without uploading the content, and partner platforms match new uploads against it [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]].

## StopNCII: for adults, step by step

StopNCII.org is run by the UK charity SWGfL for images taken when the person in them was 18 or older. By November 2025 it was protecting 2 million images, up 97% on 2024, and had supported over 785,000 cases since its launch four years before [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]]. Those numbers count images people asked to protect, not images found and removed.

1. Use a phone or computer that is yours alone.
2. On StopNCII.org, start a case and confirm that you are the person in the image and were 18 or older when it was taken.
3. Select the photos or videos. The files stay on your device.
4. Save the case number and PIN; you need them to check on the case or withdraw it.
5. Keep reporting new copies on each platform. StopNCII does not search the internet for you: it gives the fingerprints to partner platforms, and only they act on them [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]].

Men and trans people can use it too.

## Take It Down: for images taken under 18
